This paper takes the thin aluminum plate as the research object, uses Ansoft finite element simulation software, and uses the square wave pulse to stimulate the aluminum plate with different thickness to carry on the examination. It is found that the time-domain and frequency-domain features of the detection differential signal show a certain degree of regularity with the thickness of the aluminum plate. After analysis, the relationship between zero-crossing time, voltage amplitude and aluminum thickness was obtained.

articleTitle: Iterative Reweighted Quantile Regression Using Augmented Lagrangian Optimization for Baseline Correction
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Based on baseline is a smooth curve and under the collected spectrum, a robust penalized quantile regression with B-spline basis has been proposed to baseline estimation. Then an iterative reweighted method has been adopted for quantile regression optimization. Instead of man tuning the hyperparameter in penalized quantile regression, augmented Lagrangian method is applied to hyperparameter optimization. Experiments on simulated and real data sets show that our method is more effective in baseline correction than other baseline estimation methods in simulated data set. For real data set, the calibration results after the baseline correction step are better than other preprocessing and baseline correction methods.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control Approach on Packet Dropout Prevention of Networked Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A strategy towards stochastic packet dropout of networked control system is proposed in this paper. A reconfigured linear parameter-varying model of networked control system is established on the basis of some preliminaries and assumptions. A stochastic process of packet dropout in both the forward and feedback paths is modeled as a Bernoulli distribution sequence. An explicit model predictive controller with consideration of the worst case is employed in dealing with such a linear parameter-varying system. Finally, we present a Simulink numeric simulation and demonstrate both the stability and robustness of proposed control strategy in order to prove the feasibility and stability of proposed method.

Author Keywords: networked control system, model predictive control, linear parameter-varying

articleTitle: Research on Model of Network Rumor Propagation
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the era of vigorous development network media, rumors propagation procedure becomes more complex, faster, and more dangerous. The identification and control of Internet rumors is important to related net-check departments. This paper establish an index system to evaluate the level of internet rumors and rumor credibility index system according to characteristics of rumor propagation, and analysis the advantages and disadvantages of the models through experimental verification.

Author Keywords: rumor propagation audience crowd event credibility rumor harm

articleTitle: Low Slow Small Aircraft Surveillance System Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Recently, low slow small (LSS) aircrafts have become more widely used. However, most LSS aircrafts cannot be detected by air traffic control systems due to their small size, slow speed and low height, which would pose threat to public safety. In this paper, we design and implement an LSS aircraft surveillance system based on computer vision by combing single shot multibox detector (SSD) and robust scale-adaptive mean-shift for tracking (ASMS) algorithms, hotspot region generation strategy and matching control. In our system, the SSD detects aircraft target, and then the ASMS tracks the target. The hotspot region generation strategy provides some hotspot areas to improve the object recognition effect of the small-scale target. Next, matching control calculates the fit rotation of the optical turret and the appropriate camera angle to surveil the aircraft of different scales, distances and speeds automatically. Field experiments show that the system can be applied to the LSS aircraft identification and tracking to protect airspace security.

articleTitle: Anti-Interference Control of Unmanned Helicopter Based on Output Feedback
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Taking a small unmanned helicopter as the object, each part of the body stress distribution are analyzed by adopting the fission method in this paper. An unmanned helicopter flight dynamics model was established according to the balance of force and moment balance equations. Based on the model, complete all the balancing calculation of unmanned helicopter flight condition, and the linear state space model is obtained by the result of balancing. The problem of the parameters perturbation of the control system and the disturbance of the external environment during the flight of the unmanned helicopter are discussed, the static output feedback control algorithm of H∞ control theory is introduced to solve controller design problem. The simulation results show that the established model has higher accuracy, consistent with the basic characteristics of real helicopter, verify the effectiveness of the proposed modeling method. The H∞ control method achieves better control of the attitude of the unmanned helicopter under disturbance, indicating that the algorithm has a good robust decoupling and tracking characteristics. The design is suitable for anti-interference control of unmanned helicopters.

Author Keywords: unmanned helicopter, H∞ control, flight control, static output feedback

articleTitle: Configurable and Modular Development of Multi-Channel Motion Control Encoder Feedback System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to quickly help users verify motor control algorithms without concern with underlying code-driven implementation with encoders, the paper designed a system for encoder feedback. We implemented common encoder protocols based on FPGA, and packaged them as modules in Simulink. At the same time, PCI Express communication is implemented to ensure data high-speed and real-time transmission. The users in Simulink can flexible configure and select the encoder protocol, acquisition frequency, acquisition channels and other parameters to meet different needs. This system has high flexibility and applicability, which can help the motion control system get feedback quickly.

articleTitle: Research on the Intelligent Vehicle Terminal of Taxi for Energy Measurement and Metering-Billing
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to promote the energy saving and emission reduction in the taxi industry, and improve the management mode of the new business such as the ride-hailing service. This paper studied the system architecture and performance index of taxi multi-function integrated terminal. The research applied the Beidou satellite positioning precision measurement technology in the vehicle terminal for remote monitoring and testing. It also developed an energy consumption acquisition module based on OBD(on-board diagnostic system) to read the vehicle status, which including the speed, travlled distance, oil consumption and the engine parameters. This paper studies the high performance integrated Beidou positioning module which supports Beidou and GPS, which can obtain the information such as the vehicle position, driving speed, driving direction, driving angle and so on. It set up the metering - billing module based on the taxi automatic sampling test and Taxi fares adjustment, provided real-time monitoring of taxi metering - billing and fares adjustment data automatic update for measurement and supervision department, and embed the safety control module. Therefore, the taxi service level, the energy conservation and emission reduction can be improved.

Author Keywords: Taxi, smart car terminal, Beidou satellite positioning, metering-billing, energy conservation and emission reduction

articleTitle: Research on Performance Diagnosis Method of Power User Eleco Energy Data Acquire System Based on Semi-Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the overall coverage of power users' electricity information collection and the continuous growth of mining business, higher requirements are placed on the stability and reliability of the system. In order to solve the problems such as passive and incomplete in manual monitoring and diagnosis, an intelligent diagnosis method based on semi-supervised learning is proposed. Technologies such as Ping/Traceroute, SNMP protocol, SQL scripts and message queues are used to monitor and collect performance information of power-using information mining system, as well as information of related hardware devices and middleware in real time. Then store all kinds of monitoring information in a distributed manner. Finally, a performance diagnostic model of the system is constructed based on the semi-supervised learning algorithm, which can achieve intelligent diagnosis and early warning of system abnormalities. Experimental results show that this method can accurately diagnose system anomalies and provide technical support for quick elimination of failures and elimination of equipment hazards.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Influence of Ground Screen Parameters on Antenna Radiation Performance in VHF Band
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper takes the VHF band radio interference array antenna of Yunnan observatory site as an example. The influence of different ground on the radiation characteristics of the antenna is simulated by HFSS (High Frequency Simulator Structure) electromagnetic simulation software, and the radiation characteristics of the antenna after adding the ground network below the antenna are simulated. Simultaneously, the structure parameters of the single antenna ground screen in the 30-70 MHz frequency band are obtained. Without ground screen, the gain of antenna on the dry grounds are 3.06 dB and 1.435 dB, on the moist grounds are 4.327 dB and 4.246 dB. After placing the ground screen, the gain of the antenna on the dry grounds are 4.869 dB and 4.971 dB, on the moist grounds are 4.286 dB and 4.403 dB. The ground screen can not only stabilize the performance of antenna, but also effectively improve the radiation characteristics of the antenna.

articleTitle: Analysis and Study on the Interference of Wind Farms to the New Generation Weather Radar Echoes
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As a clean and renewable energy source, wind energy has attracted more attention from all countries in the world. At the same time, wind farms have become more obvious in the interference of new generation weather radar echoes, which has seriously affected the analysis and judgment of the weather forecast. Taking Ji'nan Radar as an example, the wind power interference database was established to analyze the factors related to wind farms on the echoes of the new generation of weather radar, and corresponding conclusions were drawn. This has a certain significance for further research on the principle of wind power interference and eliminating radar clutter.

Author Keywords: interference, wind farm, radar, air disturbance

articleTitle: Study on Ride Comfort of the Articulated Dump Truck
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper reports on investigations of the 60t articulated dump truck rear suspension structure and ride comfort analysis. The articulated dump truck which is different from the rigid-frame dump truck has two frames jointed by a hinge. The article first establishes two nonlinear mathematical models to compare and analyze the ride comfort of the articulated truck with two different rear suspension structures, the results show that the swing arm balance beam structure can be used as the rear suspension. And then a dynamic simulation model of the articulated truck with ADAMS is established. The simulation results show that the load, road, speed have influences on the ride comfort, and unsprung mass have little effect on ride comfort, but have a certain influence on the wheel dynamic load. All the results provide theoretical basis for the truck design.

Author Keywords: articulated dump truck, ride comfort, suspension, model

articleTitle: Numerical Modeling of Nonlinear Thermomechanical Processes in a Rod of Variable Cross Section in the Presence of Heat Flow
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A horizontal rod of limited length is considered. Radius of the rod varies linearly along its length. The cross-sectional area of the left end is greater than the right one. The lateral surface of the test rod is completely insulated. The heat flow is fed to the cross-sectional area of the left end. Through the cross-sectional area of the right end of the rod, heat exchange takes place with the surrounding medium. The field of distribution of temperature, displacement, three components of deformation and stresses are determined in the work, provided that both ends of the rod are rigidly fixed. And also, the magnitude of the elongation of the rod is determined when one end of the rod is fixed and when the other is free. In the case of fixing the two ends of the rod, the magnitude of the resulting axial compressive force is also calculated. When studying the rod, the fundamental laws of conservation of energy were used.

Author Keywords: Elongation, axial force, cross-section, temperature, displacement, deformation, stress

articleTitle: Design of a Position Controller for PMSM with Compensation of Nonideal Back-EMF Effect
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the position control of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) and proposes a control framework based on adaptive robust control (ARC) as a solution. Slightly different from the conventional one, a novel PMSM model considering nonideal back-EMF effect is first developed, which is subject to parametric uncertainties and uncertain nonlinearities. An adaptive robust controller with guaranteed tracking performance is then described. The proposed controller can compensate the effect of nonideal back-EMF and other parametric uncertainties adaptively, while the uncompensated disturbances and the estimation errors also can be handled. The tracking performance of the proposed control algorithm for position control of PMSM is evaluated by simulation results.

articleTitle: Subjective and Objective Comprehensive Evaluation of Cockpit Operation Efficiency Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The ergonomic design of the aircraft cockpit directly affects the pilots' operating experience, which is related to the comfort, convenience and flight safety of the aircraft. The subjective and objective comprehensive evaluation method of the operating efficiency in the cockpit, based on virtual reality, is proposed in this paper. It combines the advantages of both the physical and virtual prototypes to achieve the qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the ergonomics. Firstly, this paper defines the component of the virtual cockpit modelling and the mapping relationship between real space and virtual space. This demonstrates the virtual reality model of the cockpit and constructs the foundation for the ergonomic analysis. As a result, the subjective and objective evaluation indexes are put forward, establishing a comprehensive evaluation process of "subjective qualitative and objective quantitative", and achieving a comprehensive assessment oriented to the ergonomics. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed evaluation method in this paper is verified by ergonomic analysis of the joystick.

articleTitle: 3D Waveform Oscilloscope Implemented on Coupled FPGA-GPU Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: FPGA is widely adopted in computing acceleration. In recent years, the embedded GPU on mobile SoC supports OpenCL development which allows GPU to be used in the general-purpose computing. However, the study of cooperation of FPGA and SoC-based mobile GPU in an embedded system is still lacking. We propose methods of cooperation of the FPGA and GPU, which supports software and hardware task partition and unified development by OpenCL. We build an embedded system the storage oscilloscope which supports 3D waveform display. The performance of algorithms such as string matching, matrix operations, histogram, grayscale stretching, are analyzed on the ARM processor, GPU and FPGA. The results show that the coupled FPGA-GPU embedded system achieves approached performance to the pure FPGA with no more than 15% DSP slice resource.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Large Data Analysis Function of Chinese National Knowledge Infrastructure Based on Mountain Tourism Research in China
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: More and more scholars use big data as a literature analysis tool and have made certain achievements. But few study has evaluated this method. This paper makes an attempt on this problem by using the big data analysis function of Chinese National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI) database. The 4 statistical functions of "Quantity Change", "Keywords Co-occurrence Network", "Research Institutions" and "Research Hierarchy Distribution", which are included in "Metering Visualization Analysis" brought by CNKI itself, are used to discuss the current research status of mountain tourism in China. The result shows that, "Metering Visualization Analysis" is useful and effective. Although it is one of the best statistical tools in literature review, which can help us grasp the main research status as a whole, it still has some limitations. Using big data to analyze the literatures should be fully integrated into the subject background to further explore the statistical results. And the function of big data analysis must be refined and improved by technicians further on. Only in this way can we acquire the ideas, methods and results of certain papers in details, and master the main current situation of certain research as well as the trend of future development.

articleTitle: Research on Network Scalability of Energy Management System in Ship Integrated Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the increasing degree of equipment informatization in ship integrated power system, higher requirements have been raised for network scalability of energy management system. Based on the optimization principle of network topology scalability, circular topology and double-tree topology were comparatively analyzed from four aspects: hierarchicalization, modularization, invulnerability and flexibility. The scalability evaluation index and the network evaluation model of invulnerability were constructed. Based on test cases, with different number of nodes, key evaluation indexes (throughput, latency, impact scope of faults, failover time and network invulnerability measurement) of circular topology and double-tree topology were tested and analyzed horizontally and vertically. Results indicate that double-tree topology has equal network path lengthand can guarantee fault-isolation, time-ordered, real-time characteristics. Therefore, the double-tree topology is more scalable with the increase of the network size.

articleTitle: The Use of NoSQL in Product Traceability System Construction
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Product traceability system is one significant part of the modern production system, and it supports the product quality assurance by providing traceable life-cycle information about one product. By using entity-relationship model and relational database to construct a product traceability system, some problems arise when facing complex products. Three problems include entity/table explosion, query disaster and sorting problem are analyzed, then NoSQL is adopted to overcome these disadvantages. Finally, a case study about a product traceability system for pleurotus eryngii cultivation is introduced. The result demonstrates that the document type NoSQL can fix the entity/table explosion, query disaster and sorting problem easily. This solution can be used as references to those products that have plenty of unstructured production components, stages and process.

articleTitle: Process Online Checking Model of Internetware Based on Time Petri Net
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Internetware is the basic paradigm of the new generation of network software. The Internetware process model is built online in accordance with users' requirements. Therefore, before the Internetware provides the service to the user, it is necessary to perform online detection of the process model of the Internetware. In the paper, first of all, according to the characteristics of high order coordination, real-time and temporal characteristics of data flow and control flow interaction between the components of the Internetware, process online checking model (POCM) of Internetware based on time petri net is put forward; Secondly, from two aspects of time constraint scheduling of control flow, time limit scheduling of control flow and data flow, the POCM time consistency constraint is established, and the schedule ability criterion of Internetware process model is formed; Then, according to the data flow characteristics of POCM, the basic item operation constraint expression and logical constraint expression between data items are established, which ensure the correctness of the software data content. Through the above work, the online detection of the Internetware process model is effectively supported.

Author Keywords: internetware, petri net, online checking, activity schedulability, data correctness

articleTitle: Influence of Oxide Scale on Continuous Casting Billet on Thickness Measurement by Electromagnetic Ultrasonic Transducer
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to study the nondestructive testing mechanism of solidification shell thickness measurement in secondary cooling zone of continuous casting, the influence of oxide scale on the thickness of continuous casting billet shell by electromagnetic ultrasonic testing is analyzed. Finite element simulation software is used to simulate the thickness measurement system of oxidizing billet and oxide free iron billet., the distribution law of eddy current, magnetic field and displacement field on the surface layer of two kinds of billet skin layer is compared, and the influence of oxide scale on electromagnetic ultrasonic thickness measurement system is analyzed. Finally, the experimental results verify the correctness of the simulation analysis, and provide a theoretical reference for the design of non-destructive detection device for continuous casting solidified shell thickness by pulse electromagnetic ultrasonic sensor.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based Image Storage in Flash Lidar
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The forms and signal processing methods of LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) echo signal are becoming more and more complex. In order to ensure the reliability and accuracy of signal processing, we need to collect and store LiDAR echo signal for researching and analyzing in real time. The existing acquisition and storage system are difficult to meet the requirements of high-speed acquisition, long-time continuous storage and large capacity. A data storage system based on FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Arrays) and SDRAM (Synchronous Dynamic Random Access Memory) is designed in this paper. The system has the advantages of strong portability and low cost. It can be applied flexibly to different projects according to the needs of the designers.

articleTitle: Two Variants of the Full Steiner Tree Construction Problems
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Research on the full Steiner tree problem in the Euclidean plane R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> has important theoretic significance, and it also has broad applications in material construction, VLSI design, WDM optical networks and wireless communications. In this paper, combining with the material construction and the actual cost, we introduce two new variants of the full Steiner tree problem in the Euclidean plane R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>: the minimumlength full Steiner tree problem (MLFST, for short) and the minimum-number of Steiner points in the full Steiner tree problem (MNPFST, for short). These problems are both NP-hard, and we design one approximation algorithm for each of them which have important applications in real life. To enhance the convenience of application, a subdivision procedure method and a minimum disk cover of points method are adopted in some designed algorithms.

articleTitle: Influence of Complex Terrains on Electric Field under Overhead Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the paper, electric field under overhead lines with complex terrains is studied. It's regarded as two dimension problem for simplification. Charge simulation method and surface charge method are used with line charges representing conductors and surface charges representing the ground. Four types of terrains are calculated. Calculating results show that increment of height enlarges electric field and abrupt increment of height has also shielding effect on nearby region. Change of terrain departing away from overhead lines has little influence on peak of electric field under overhead lines.

articleTitle: Research of Brain Network on Deception Identification Using Phase Synchrony
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Recently many researches have focused on the lie detection (LD) using the event-related-potentials (ERPs) of EEG signals. Deception is a complex cognition process which involves activities in different brain regions. However, most of current ERP-based LD systems only focus on extracting the various features from the EEG signals on one or few channels. In this study, we used the phase lag index (PLI) to establish brain network connections and applied graph theory approach to investigate structure features in functional networks. Thirty participants were required to tell the truth or lie when facing certain stimuli, and their EEG signals were recorded. Statistical analysis indicates that the differences in the extracted graph-based features between the two groups were significant. Furthermore, calculated result shows that the guilty group shows more obvious small-world property than the innocent group, which provides a new approach that could automatically identify the deception in future.

articleTitle: Mobile Robots Location and Mapping Based on Corner Features
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In an unknown environment, the robot creates a map by recognizing the surroundings, and locates and navigates by the map. In this paper, the feature points are extracted, and used as landmark to synchronize the robots positioning and mapping tasks by the EKF SLAM method. When the robot obtains an environment map, it determines that is in the position of changing the map and estimates the map along the route. First, the assumption of Gaussian noise for the motion and prediction of the robot makes little the sum of the post-verification uncertainties. Then, the information of landmark in map and the robot pose will be described by the same state vector which is a matrix of 3 rows and 19 columns. Inertial navigation is used to pre-estimate the pose of the robot, then the robots pose and corner map information can be got to update the state vector by the method of EKF-SLAM. Simulation experiment proves that the algorithm used in this paper can accurately reflect the environmental information and achieve positive location result.

articleTitle: Labeled Bilingual Topic Model for Cross-Lingual Text Classification and Label Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the increasingly rich multi language information resources and multi-label data in news reports and scientific literatures, in order to mining the relevance between languages and the correlation between data, this paper proposed labeled bilingual topic model, applied on cross-lingual text classification and label recommendation. First of all, it could assume that the keywords in the scientific literature are relevant to the abstract in same article, then extracted the keywords and regarded it as labels, and aligned the labels with topics in topic model, instantiated the “latent” topic. Secondly, trained the abstracts in article through the topic model proposed by this paper. Finally, classified the new documents by cross-lingual text classifier, also recommended the labels. The experiment result show that Micro-F1 measure reaches 94.81% in cross-lingual text classification task, and the recommended labels also reflects the sematic relevance with documents.

articleTitle: A Task Scheduling Mechanism Based on Quartz of Power Consumption Information Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the continuous growth of new business, the collection task of the user's power consumption information collection system is growing day by day, and the task scheduling is becoming increasingly complex. In order to adapt to the increasingly diverse and complicated task scheduling requirements, common scheduling frameworks and current user power consumption information collection system scheduling mechanisms are firstly compared and analyzed. Then the quartz scheduling framework is mainly studied, and a task scheduling mechanism based on the quartz framework is designed. The task scheduling mechanism proposed in this paper is easy to use. With the introduction of clustering mechanism, the system has a better scalability and fault tolerance, also load balancing can be achieved.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of a PAN-TILT System for Multirotor UAV Application
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a multi-objective optimization design method for a Pan-Tilt system based on unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) for aerial remote sensing application. Firstly, the approximate model on the Pan-Tilt system is proposed to improve the structure optimization efficiency. The approximate model about mass and first-order modal frequency is established by using both of response surface model and radial basis function (RBF) neural network model. Then, the sensitivity analysis is conducted to determine the optimized design parameters. By the proposed way, the multi-objective optimization design is realized. At last, the modal experiments are carried out as a validation on the optimization method.

articleTitle: Locust Image Segmentation by Fusion of Multiple Colors
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: It is not easy to identify locust because of dense locusts and complex environment. In this paper, we propose an effective image segmentation method for locust images which selects a group of color features. First, extract the color feature values from some different color spaces according to locust and background, and establish a corresponding feature database. Secondly, using trained support vector machine (SVM) model to identify and classify locust images. Finally, Otsu algorithm with appropriate threshold is exploited to further segment the image. The experiment results indicate that the proposed algorithm can obtain a relative better segmentation results compared with the method used single color feature. At the same time, the training model can effectively separate locust images in different situations. The results provide a scientific basis for accurate and effective detection of the locust occurrence area and density. It is an important way to achieve modern locust disaster monitoring and early warning.

articleTitle: Well-Posedness Exploration of Solutions for a Class of Coupling Partial Differential Equations
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A multi-physical field model is proposed for image processing problem, which combines nonlinear diffusion equation and Darcy's law. The model is reduced to a class of initial boundary value problem of partial differential equations (PDEs) and has obvious physical background. The well-posedness problem is studied. Then, existence and uniqueness of weak solutions are established.

articleTitle: Research on a Method for Mobile Robot Localization
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, a new method for mobile robot localization was proposed, which combines support vector regression (SVR) with gradient optimization (GO) algorithm. In order to obtain better robustness, support vector regression (SVR) algorithm was studied, the error square of objective function was weighted and the parameters of SVR was optimized by GO. The experimental platform was established by homemade mobile robot with orthogonal encoders and gyroscope positioning system, and the positioning model and kinematics model of robot were analyzed. With the purpose of verifying the performance of the improved algorithm and the proposed positioning system, the improved algorithm was compared with the least squares support vector regression (LSSVR) algorithm and the weighted least squares support vector regression (WLSSVR) algorithm. In addition, the positioning error of the proposed positioning system was compared with the double encoder positioning system and the single encoder fusion gyroscope positioning system. Experimental results indicate that the positioning accuracy of robot is higher by the improved algorithm than comparison algorithms, and the proposed positioning system has a better location performance.

articleTitle: A Novel Stacked Regression Algorithm Based on Slice Transform for Small Sample Size Problem in Spectroscopic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In spectroscopic data analysis, small sample size (SSS) problem occurs. A solution is to perform variable selection, which has been proved to be critical to improve the performance of the regression model, such as partial least squares (PLS) regression. Stacked moving window partial least squares (SMWPLS) aims to combine variable sets instead of selecting a subset to improve the model robustness. In this study, we proposed a novel weighting strategy to calculate the combination weights. Slice transform (SLT) is used to map the cross-validation (CV) weights to new weights in a piecewise linear manner. The parameters of SLT are optimized with the least-square criterion. Experiments on two near-infrared (NIR) data sets demonstrated the efficiency of the proposed SLT weighting.

articleTitle: Study on Swing-up Control of Rotary Inverted Pendulum Based on Energy Feedback
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To study the control of the rotary inverted pendulum system, the author in this paper proposed a swing-up method based on energy control. Through analysis the energy of the pendulum rod during the whole swing-up, and introduce the angle of the pendulum as a feedback coefficient to reduce the swing-up time, the author came up with the swing-up control method. Acquire better input with the help of giving different parameters repeatedly using Matlab/Simulink simulation and finish the experimentation finally. The simulation results and the experimental data indicate that the method can drive the pendulum from its hanging-down position to the upright position well. Finally it conclude that this energy method is appropriate for the rotary inverted pendulum system.

articleTitle: Integrated Design of Structure and Control of Motor Servo System Based on Improved Gravitational Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a structure and control integrated design method for motor servo systems. Due to the existence of the coupling between the structure and the controller, the control performance is influenced by structure parameters. An integral sliding mode tracking controller is designed for the motor servo system. To achieve a better control performance, an integrated cost function is built considering both structure and controller parameters. The weight-based gravitational search algorithm is used to jointly optimize controller parameters and structural parameters of the system so that an integrated design of the system's structure and control can be achieved. The effectiveness of the algorithm is proved by comparison simulation.

articleTitle: ID Authentication in PTPM and Public Key Cryptography in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To tackle the problems of security threat and the shortcomings in the process of ID authentication between user and cloud, this paper applies Portable TPM chip and certificateless public key cryptography for the first time to solve the issues in the cloud environment, and proposes a scheme for bidirectional ID authentication between user and cloud. Compared with previous authentication schemes, the proposed scheme has the several advantages. First, based on the unique identity of user and cloud by the identity management mechanism, portable TPM can not only achieves secure and trusted terminal platform, which ensures the authentication result between user and cloud is correct and valid, but also supports the objectives of ID authentication between user and cloud in user's any terminal device. Furthermore, Dual-factor ID authentication (password + key) is implemented with certificateless public key signature algorithm provided by the new scheme. Finally, security proof and performance analysis show that this proposed scheme has the security level of EUF-CMA, and the computation overhead of ID authentication between user and cloud is significantly improved.

Author Keywords: cloud computing, ID authentication, PTPM, certificateless public key cryptography

articleTitle: A Study on Forward Problem for Surface-Hole Measurement Data of Polarization Sphere
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Polarization sphere is an ideal model for describing geological targets such as ore bodies, and its forward response signals can provide useful orientation and lithologic information for related geological interpretation in borehole geophysical exploration work. In this paper, we study the fast forward modeling of surface-hole measurement data of polarized spheres. We choose the analytic solution in the spherical coordinate system as the basic algorithm of forward motion, to simulate the responses of the different borehole induced polarization devices (including five direction observation device and symmetric direction observation device) in different conditions. Then, we get systematic summary of pattern for surface-hole measurement data of polarization sphere from the forward modeling results and conversion parameters. The forward calculation result and analysis conclusion can be used as references for relevant researches or actual production work.

articleTitle: Accelerating Storage System Performances with NVRAM Cache by Considering Storage Access Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: NVRAM is being considered as an additional memory/storage component of future computer systems. This paper investigates how much performance gain can be obtained if we add NVRAM as the memory/storage component of computer systems. Specifically, we present a storage system accelerator that utilizes a small size of NVRAM cache. To do so, we formally define the NVRAM caching problem and analyze the storage access patterns that can be exploited in managing NVRAM cache. Our analysis shows that there are more than 40% of single-write data in storage I/Os due to periodic flushes triggered from the host side. Based on this observation, we show that acceleration of storage performance can be maximized by using NVRAM as a selective storage cache device. Empirical evaluation results show that our storage architecture with flush-aware NVRAM cache reduces the total I/O time by 26% on average and up to 62% compared to the case that does not use our scheme.

Author Keywords: NVRAM, storage system, storage cache, storage accelerator, I/O

articleTitle: Intelligent Collision Detection with Dynamic Obstacles in 2D and 3D Space Based on Human Behavior
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The aim of this research is to finalize implementation of new method and algorithm of Collaborative and Non-Collaborative Dynamic Path Prediction for Mobile objects Collision Detection with Dynamic Obstacles in 2D and 3D Space. The method is based human behavior in collision detection with vehicles in real-life natural environment. Advantages of proposed method are full decentralization of the system, minimizing network traffic and simplifying inclusion of additional agents in the system. The proposed method is inspired by nature and implemented in mobile robotics. The method decreases uncertainty and increases predictability in collision detection with dynamic obstacles. Method allows implementation of fully functional algorithm which is tested in experimental environment and shows excellent results both in collaborative mode using exchange of coordinates as well as non-collaborative mode using OpenCV library for computer imaging and mobile objects tracking. The proposed algorithm is named Sliding Holt algorithm. This research paper should be considered as a part of series of research papers published earlier.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Saving of High Pressure Water Descaling Based on NLPQL Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The method of high pressure water descaling has become the main effective technique for the scaly treatment of hot rolling production line at domestic and abroad up till the present moment, and the use of the speed regulation for variable-frequency pump has obvious energy-saving effects. The AMESim model of high-pressure water descaling system composed of pump accumulator and pipeline valve is presented in the paper. The Co-simulation model of AMESim and Matlab/Simulink is established, and the system parameter optimization algorithm based on NLPQL is proposed under the given working condition. The simulation results show that, under the premise of satisfying descaling pressure and flow and ensuring that the pump operates in an efficient range (no less than 70%), the method can find the optimal speed of the variable-frequency pump and the characteristic parameters of the system piping, thereby reducing the energy consumption of the pump.

articleTitle: Research on an Improved Algorithm for Wireless Network Maximum Throughput Based on COPE Protocol
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Network coding has reached a goal of significant throughput improvement. Previous work has analyzed the two main features of the COPE protocol: "opportunistic listening" and "opportunistic coding", but in some scenarios, it does not work well on Encoding. In order to further enhance the throughput of COPE protocol for wireless transmission, this paper proposes a new approach based on "opportunistic asynchronous transmission coding CACM". A comparative simulation experiments on four different transport protocol is performed and the result shows that the throughput of COPE, CACM-nP and CACM protocols has been significantly improved by 122%, 133% and 139% respectively over the Unicast protocol. This work provides a guidance for further designing routing / MAC on network coding.

articleTitle: An Indoor Wireless Positioning System Based on Ibeacon
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Using the Apple's Ibeacon low-power Bluetooth application technology, with the embedded device as a carrier and the design of the QT graphical interface software, the indoor wireless positioning technology is realized. The technology has the advantages of fast response and high precision. It can be applied to various real-time detection experiments and development projects with the features of small size and easy movement of embedded devices.

articleTitle: Complete Model for System with Uncertain Heavy Load Disturbance and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of national defense and economy, the control performance of heavy equipment is increasingly demanding. Establishing a complete and accurate mathematical model is an important requirement to control the heavy load disturbance system accurately because load is an important part of the ship steering system. A general model with random and uncertain disturbances is proposed and applied to a ship steering system. In the course of navigation, the uncertainty of the ship's load, the random disturbances made by the waves, ocean currents and the sea wind will all affect the ship’s course. The ship steering gear system is a typical electro- hydraulic servo system, which has the characteristics of large inertia, uncertainty and heavy load disturbance, random disturbance and nonlinearity. The analysis and modeling results show that the ship steering gear system is a high order, non-self-balancing complex system, and the external control and disturbance have a serious effect on the rudder blade angle. Therefore, establishing complete system models, including stochastic and uncertain disturbances, is of great significance for system analysis and control.

articleTitle: A Fault Propagation Model for FPGA Netlist with Un-Reconvergence Paths
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an analysis method of fault propagation based on the FPGA netlist with un-reconvergence path. First of all, we analyze the characteristics of common components in the netlist, calculate the fault propagation probability of these components, and then establish a netlist-level fault propagation model based on the interconnection topological structure of the components in the netlist. When a fault happens at input ports of the netlist, we analyze the fault propagation characteristics in the whole netlist, calculate the probability of the fault propagating from input to output ports, and find out the input port which is most likely to cause the fault. Finally, we verify the model presented in this paper by experiments. The experimental results show that the estimated error of fault propagation probability is negligible. It is less than 0.1% compared to the corresponding testing results.

articleTitle: An Improved Algorithm for Intervisibility Judgment Based on RSG
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The intervisibility judgment algorithm is one of the most important algorithms in military simulation system. In view of the problem that the existing intervisibility algorithms are inefficient and do not consider the influence of the curvature of the earth. This paper improves the existing intervisibility algorithm through calculating the slope of the connection line of the sight point and target point before selecting sampling points. According to the different slopes, different sampling strategies are adopted, and the slope determination method is used to replace the original altitude data determination method, in addition, the influence of the curvature of the earth is also incorporated into the intervisibility judgment algorithm. The improved algorithm proposed in this paper avoids complicated interpolation calculation process, and the sampling process is more flexible. The experimental results show that the improved intervisibility algorithm can effectively improve the operating efficiency, shorten the system runtime, and improve the accuracy of the intervisibility judgment.

articleTitle: A New Dynamic Test Method for Amplitude Frequency Response of Broadcast Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In view of the disadvantages of the traditional static measurement methods, such as low efficiency, inconvenient storage of data and higher requirements for the testers, a dynamic measurement method for real-time online measurement of the amplitude frequency response of the broadcasting transmitter is proposed, and the model and test principle of the measurement system are explained. In this method, the input and output signals of the broadcast transmitter are collected in real time. First, the generalized cross correlation algorithm is used to find the system delay, and then the system amplitude-frequency response is calculated by the FFT algorithm of time delay data interception. Experiments show that the method is accurate and reliable, so it has good practicability and generalization.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling of Thermal Control Loop
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The traditional thermal process controller optimization design often simplifies the loop into a controller and a generalized controlled object. It does not consider the influence of the actuator and the sensor's own characteristics in the system. The controller parameters obtained are only for the specific external conditions, far away from the actual application. In order to improve the design level of controller, according to the structure of thermal control loop, intelligent identification method and sample data preprocessing are used to modeling the different parts of control loop, taking into account the connection relationship and signal transmission delay, and then get modular mathematical model of control loop. At the same time, the accuracy and effectiveness of the modeling process are verified by an example of main steam temperature control loop. Through this identification method, the design level of controller can be improved and the quality of control improved.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Time Scale Battery Energy Storage Modeling Technology and Power Stabilization Strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to study the influence of distributed generation on the power grid during the transient and medium-long-term dynamic process of the distribution network, the influence of the modeling time scale on the transient process of the distribution network is studied, and the storage system of the battery is modeled in detail. Power generation and networking to provide research tools. On this basis, this paper analyzes the characteristics of the energy storage battery system at different time scales, studies its transient characteristics and the influence of the battery storage system access on the power grid, and puts forward the power stabilization strategy of the multi-time scale storage unit system. The strategy is validated.

articleTitle: Automation of Waste Treatment on the Washer Machine Based on PLC Control System in the Manufacturing Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents research conducted in the manufacturing industry, in Indonesia. This manufacturing industry is the manufacturer of valve engine parts or also called valve engines. In the processing of industrial waste, this company cannot manage all its own waste results to the maximum so that it can disrupt the workings of the machine resulting in downtime. In an effort to manage waste and maintain the quality of the machine, we do research to separate waste oil on manual washer machine to extend the period of usage of water washer, which is by making machine waste processing tool automatically based on PLC (Programmable Logic Controller). We use the precipitation method to separate the waste in the water washer. The precipitation method is to allow the mixture of waste oil and water washer within the specified time period, so that the used oil can be drained to the maximum and the water washer can be reused on the manual washer machine. This system works automatically using PLC with the number of Input-Output required as many as 13 addresses. The program created has 2 menus, the manual and automatic menus. Finally, this system has worked automatically, then the washing process becomes faster 2 minutes each washing process. Used oil and water washer that has been deployed does not need to be processed by a waste company so the company only removes used oil and does not need to spend to dispose of waste water. This is because the water washer can be reused by manual washer machine.

articleTitle: A Fractional-Order Memristive System with Time-Delay and No Equilibrium Points
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A fractional-order delayed memristive chaotic system is presented in this paper. Abundant dynamic behaviors of the designed fractional-order delayed memristive circuit were investigated by numerical simulation. Specially, Through the analysis of the stability of the system, we found this fractional-order delayed memristive system can generate chaotic attractors although it possesses no equilibrium point.

articleTitle: An Information Hiding Method Based on Conditional Selection Statement Execution Paths
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the development of information technology, a greater challenge to network security has been put forward. Information hiding is another important way to protect information besides the traditional information encryption technology. In this paper we propose a new method of information hiding based on conditional selection. This method is based on the fact that conditional selection statements have different execution paths, some of which can be employed to store information. Furthermore, different features of the program can be used to increase the extent to which information is hidden. Our experimental results show that the increasing number of the conditional selection statements has no significant negative effect on the execution efficiency of the original program. The method can effectively protect the software and hide information.

Author Keywords: Information hiding, Conditional selection, Coding, Execution path

articleTitle: A Pilot-Aided Bit Synchronization Method for THz Communication System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a pilot-aided bit synchronization method for the THz communication system. By inserting a low-power mono pilot into the data signal in frequency domain, making the bit offset of the data signal equal to the frequency offset of the pilot. So we can easily extract the bit offset through processing the pilot, where FFT operation is employed. Theoretical analyses and simulations show that this method greatly reduces the amount of computations by 6 orders of magnitude, saves the hardware resources, simplifies hardware implementation, ensures a sufficiently large bit offset estimation range, and almost not changes the bit error rate performance.

articleTitle: Outsourcing Resource Combinatorial Optimization of Complex Product in Cloud Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In cloud manufacturing (CMfg) environment, more and more manufacturing enterprises outsource many manufacturing activities to more professional subcontractor and focus on their core business. To address outsourcing resource (OR) combinatorial optimization for cement equipment manufacturing enterprise and reduce cost, a novel multi-objective optimization model and heuristic approach are investigated in this study. A matrix model based on ontology for outsourcing resource optimization is established. Then, an improved self-adaptive genetic algorithm (SEGA) has been developed. Finally, a case study and comparison of performances with simple genetic algorithm (SGA) and SEGA are presented. Experimental results show the proposed method is more preferably and efficient in optimal solution searching.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of an Integrated Drilling-and-Coring Demolition and Rescue Accessory
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Based on the demand for rescue and demolition technology, the design of a new integrated drilling-and-coring accessory is proposed. SolidWorks is used for the 3D design and modeling of the accessory, and the principles of both the cutting and coring states of the accessory are analyzed. In addition, the mechanical properties of the grasping mechanism and turntable are analyzed during both cutting and coring, and the strengths of each are verified in terms of design. Finally, the forces experienced by the disc saw during working conditions are analyzed. The forces experienced by the turntable are considered under inertial force conditions, coupled with the sawing forces. These simulated analyses are carried out using ADAMS™, which lays the foundation for the subsequent optimization analysis.

articleTitle: A Selecting and Repairing Method for Service Routing in Mobile Social Network
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Mobile social network is made up of people with certain social relations through some wireless devices connected together, which is a virtual interactive community based on wireless network service. Aiming at multimedia application scenario, such as video conference or multimedia contents sharing, how to improve the transmission efficiency for the data sensitive to time and ensure users' smooth and stable service experience is our object. This paper presents a selecting and repairing method for service routing in mobile social network. During the selection process for service routing, the source node which provides multimedia content adjusts the transmission rate. When the service routing is failed, the method repairs the service routing in time. The simulation results show that the proposed method can reduce the packet loss rate greatly.

articleTitle: Observer-Based Output-Feedback Controller Design for Nonlinear Switched T-S Fuzzy Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This article investigates the robust stabilization problem and proposes a state observer-based output-feedback controller for a class of nonlinear switched T-S fuzzy systems with actuator dead zone and constant time delay. The nonlinear switched fuzzy systems consist of several switched modes, and each switched mode is linear system. Based on parallel distributed compensation (PDC) technique, the robust fuzzy control law and switching law are constructed via using the Lyapunov function method, respectively. The sufficient stability conditions are proposed and parameterized in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs), which can be solved using the convex optimization techniques. Numerical simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme for the nonlinear switched T-S fuzzy systems.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Method for Typical Scenes of Microgrid (Group) Access to Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Microgrids are attracting attention since they can provide effective solutions for centralized management of DG. Firstly, the grid-connected, isolated and switching operation strategies of master-slave microgrid are studied, and an improved SPLL structure based on flexible handover is proposed. Secondly, on these basis, this paper studies the simulation method for typical scenes of microgrid (group) access to distribution network, moreover proposes a method to divide the scenes by self-powered ratio, and builds the related network topology. Finally, examples are given to simulate the operation mode of the microgrid (group) in different scenes to analyze the operational characteristics of the microgrid (group) access to grid, and the related operation strategy are verified.

articleTitle: Development of a Microcomputer Multifunctional TV Parallel Device
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, a microcomputer multifunctional TV parallel device with sectionalized configuration was designed to solve faults such as voltage parallel failure, secondary circuit voltage loss and secondary circuit reverse charge which was caused by incorrect operation or equipment failure of 35kV and below voltage TV parallel. The analog voltage criterion is increased to its parallel control logic which compares with the value of in-phase voltage of the TV secondary circuit, It does not allow to parallel when the value of in-phase voltage difference is greater than the set value. The experiments show that the protection device has higher measurement accuracy, and it could provide effective protection and monitoring for TV, thus it is able to fully meet the TV parallel needs.

articleTitle: Acoustic Analysis of the Open End Effect Using Solid Vocal Tract Models Constructed from MRI Data during Vowel Production
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper investigates acoustic effect of the vocal-tract open end to examine whether the open-end correction coefficient known to date is adequate for modeling the vocal tracts with a wide-open mouth. To do so, MRI data were examined for two females (LH and SC). 3D vocal tract shapes were extracted, and solid vocal-tract models were built from volumetric MRI data during production of Chinese vowel /a/. The measured formants from the solid models and calculated formants from the area functions were compared to estimate the wide open end boundary effect. It was found that the calculated formants with the excess lengths of 0.44 and 0.28 open end diameter for subjects LH and SC are closer to the measured formants than the calculated formants with the common open-end correction coefficients (in the range of 0.3 to 0.4 diameters of the open end). The results suggest that the coefficient for correction needs to be adjusted in models to reflect the geometry of the lip end of the vocal tract.

articleTitle: Computational Investigation of Ethanol and Bi-Fuel Applied in GDI Engine
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Computational simulation is used to investigate the feasibility of ethanol and gasoline-ethanol mixtures as a fuel in a Direct Injection (GDI) engine. A dynamic mesh of the varying compression ratio models is built to simulate flow physics, fuel injection, and combustion in the engine. Ethanol delivery from the stock fuel injector model is investigated and compared with gasoline models. Additionally, a dual-injection gasoline ethanol operation mode is investigated using the high compression ratio model 13:1. A comparison between gasoline and ethanol performance at cruising speed shows that gasoline produced 1.7Mpa more cylinder pressure (18.7% increase) and 314K more cylinder temperature (14.9% increase) under operation at the same equivalency. The bi-fuel injection timing study shows that the gasoline first injection was consistently the lowest cylinder pressure and temperature, with both standard and ethanol first offering higher pressure and temperature. The bi-fuel ignition timing study shows that cylinder pressure depends strongly on spark timing. A cylinder pressure increases 27.5% was found when comparing all the ignition timing. The bi-fuel ignition timing study shows that the cylinder pressure is maximized for E80, however, E50 and E30 have almost the same peak cylinder pressure.

articleTitle: An Ordered Interference Cancellation Detection Scheme for Oversampled OFDM System in Doubly Selective Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a linear ordered successive interference cancellation (OSIC) detection scheme for the oversampled OFDM system to improve the diversity gain and decrease the interference over the doubly selective fading channel. In the proposed scheme, the received OFDM signal is primarily processed by an oversampling module and a FFT module, then the processed data symbols are detected one by one in the order determined by comparing the post-detection signal-to-interference and noise power ratio (SINR) of the symbols, the symbol with the largest SINR is first detected based upon the MMSE and then subtracted from symbol sets, the rest symbols are reconstructed and perform the above operations until all symbols are detected. Simulation results show that the proposed method outperforms the suboptimum Doppler domain block decision feedback scheme by about 2dB for normalized Doppler shift F_d T_o= 0.5, the proposed method is able to effectively reduce the residual interference and error propagation in the low complexity, moreover, it is further suppress ICI and obtain the diversity embedded in fast time-varying channels.

articleTitle: Simulation and Modeling of Station and Shooting Model of Free Kicks
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Previous study had not yet constructed an effective system assisting players in training free kicks. We present a Simulation and Modeling of Station and Shooting Model of Free Kicks. In order to investigate the two opposite aspects of offense and defense, the station model is established after building a football field model. Then through considering the distance from corner of the goal and the speed of the ball, the best way to shoot football is solved by small steps. Finally, we simulate the station and shooting model to verify the accuracy of our model. The results showed that the proposed model is effective in football games.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Scenario Demonstration Software System for Intelligent Satellite Artificial System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper applies the theory of parallel systems to construct the scenario demonstration software framework of intelligent satellite(iSat) artificial system, and designs a scenario demonstration software system of intelligent satellite artificial system by using Eclipse platform with its integration functions. First of all, the system is designed and integrated with the control and display functions of each module of the artificial system. After that, the Satellite Tool Kit (STK) is redeveloped and embedded into the Eclipse platform, which enables the STK scenario simulation and analysis functions to be invoked. On this basis, the exchange of the internal information of the software is designed, and the interaction from the configuration file to the hardware platform and the STK scenario presentation module is realized. Finally, combined with the demonstration of a single multifunctional satellite scenario and multiple satellite networking scenarios, this paper verifies the simulation function of the intelligent satellite artificial scenario demonstration software.

articleTitle: The Influence of Operating Conditions on Discharge Characteristics for Traction Battery
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to analyze the influence of electric vehicle (EV) operation condition to electric energy metering, the discharge characteristics of battery under actual operating conditions were studied. Ternary lithium battery is taken as the research object, By monitoring the characteristics of the ripple, wave amplitude, dynamic range and load mutation of the battery discharge in the actual operating condition, the influence of the ADC resolution and sampling rate on the DC power measurement is evaluated and calculated. The research results show that the ripple change in discharge current is the key factor that affects the measurement of vehicle energy metering.

articleTitle: Design of a Multi-Threaded Positioning System Software Architecture for Ground Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a multi-threaded software architecture for integrated positioning system applied in ground mobile robots. The integrated positioning software system is mainly composed of three modules: data analysis, data processing and data transmission. In order to ensure the real-time performance of the system and meet the requirements of multi-sensor and multi-task, the integrated navigation software is designed in a multi-threaded manner, using multiple threads to simultaneously parse and process multi-sensor information and perform data fusion. Practical application effect demonstrates that the multi-threading mechanism can handle the fusion of multi-sensor data concurrently, with excellent real-time performance and robustness.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Localization Algorithm for WSN Based on Range
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the following problems that the errors of the localization algorithms are mainly due to the offset between the clock of the node itself and the standard clock, and most of existing algorithms are less concerned with the influence of the real environment on the ranging accuracy, a modified node period ratio (MNPR) localization algorithm is proposed in this paper. In this algorithm, the unknown nodes in the network are to correct the obtained distances between the anchor nodes using the period ratio of each collected anchor node and its own node clock. At the same time, the introduction of the influence factor of actual environment to signal attenuation makes the algorithm have high positioning accuracy in practical application. Considering that many localization algorithms cannot effectively locate the local sparse network, the MNPR localization algorithm is improved based on self-adaptation so that the algorithm can effectively locate the local sparse network according to the actual deployment of the nodes in the network. The simulation results show that the self-adaptive localization algorithm proposed in this paper has a relatively high ranging accuracy, positioning accuracy and good adaptation.

articleTitle: A Modified Round-Robin Load Balancing Algorithm Based on Content of Request
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Cluster web servers emerged as a reliable and leading resource in internet infrastructure with the growing demands for web-based applications. The key point is to increase utilization of cluster web servers through an effective and fair load balancing strategy. In this paper, we proposed a new load balancing algorithm, which considers the load and performance information of nodes and the type of request to solve the problem of uneven distribution of load in cluster servers. Compared the common Round-Robin algorithm, the discussed method achieves a relatively optimum load balancing result.

articleTitle: Intelligent Energy Scheduling Model Based on Block Chain Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Widespread access to distributed energy requires new demands on the decentralization of power system transactions. Block chain technology, as a reliable underlying bookkeeping and information storage technology, can effectively break through the bottleneck of current energy transactions, broaden the application prospect of multi-energy complementary control technologies, realize the integration of panoramic information in the energy transaction process, and solve the current personal Security issues in energy trading. Firstly, this paper analyzes the demand of the block chain technology in the power system's energy trading and the current development status. It focuses on analyzing the applicability of the block chain in multi-energy systems. It also proposes the construction method and necessity of multi-energy system transactions based on heterogeneous block chain technology. Finally, the model of block chain technology in energy trading is given in detail, and compared with the traditional scheduling model to illustrate the superiority of block chain technology.

articleTitle: The Factors Influence the Intention Use of Mobile Payment in Thailand E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the worldwide implementation of computer and information technology, mobile payment has become an important part of our daily life. The research on the adoption of mobile payment system will help improve the E-commerce payment service. This paper presents the research on the factors influence the intention use of mobile payment services in Thailand E-commerce field. We attempt to analyze the impact of various variables extracted from mobile, convenience, compatibility and knowledge. The results indicate that the strong predictors of the intention to use mobile payment are perceived ease of use and perceived usefulness. The paper also provide some suggestions to improve the mobile payment service in Thailand.

articleTitle: Toward Socially Optimal Bitcoin Mining
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Bitcoin is a cryptocurrency for managing and transferring money in a distributed manner. The Bitcoin network creates a complex system of economic incentives that governs its inner working, impacting the network's security guarantees and its evolution. Recent development of Bitcoin as a speculative asset and the herein skyrocketing Bitcoin price greatly incentivize participation in the network. We posit that the expansion in Bitcoin miner population and speculative transactions may not be socially desirable. The increased competition in Bitcoin mining not only exacerbates energy consumption and environmental cost, but also makes the risky mining business much riskier. In addition to the risk of unstable reward flows, the fluctuation in Bitcoin price makes the profitability of mining more uncertain. This research studies an alternative socially optimal model for the Bitcoin market (and other cryptocurrencies in general). Through equilibrium analysis, we emphasize the need to limit speculation in Bitcoin transactions, improve efficiency, diversify currency portfolio, and minimize negative externalities of the Bitcoin mining business.

Author Keywords: Cryptocurrency, Bitcoin, mining, competition, blockchain, economics, pricing, optimization, social optimum

articleTitle: Equilibrium Decision Research on Closed-Loop Supply Chain Network Based upon Carbon Emission Rights Constraint and Risk Aversion
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Considering the risk aversion characteristics of manufacturers and retailers under the constraint of carbon emission rights, the closed-loop supply chain network, which is composed of multiple competing manufacturers, retailers and demand markets, and its equilibrium decision problem was studied. Variational inequality and equilibrium theory were used to describe the equilibrium conditions of closed-loop supply chain network and the model of closed-loop supply chain network equilibrium was established under the risk aversion and the constraint of carbon emission rights.
