Research shows that there is a conflict between the economic performance and environmental performance of the closed-loop supply chain network under the constraint of carbon emission rights. When the risk aversion coefficient of closed-loop supply chain network increases, enterprises reduce product wholesale and purchase volume to avoid risks, and manufacturers decrease the trading volume, which contributes to the coordination of the network economic performance and environmental performance. What's more, the total carbon emission reduction of the closed-loop supply chain network is improved while the total utility of the network is reduced as risk aversion coefficient increases. This paper also argues that the reasonable formulation of carbon trading prices will have a positive role in promoting the actively implementation of enterprises' carbon reduction measures in closed-loop supply chain network.

Author Keywords: carbon emission rights, risk aversion, carbon trading price, closed-loop supply chain network, equilibrium decision

articleTitle: Realization of Communication Security in Substation
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As an important node of smart grid, the intelligent substation has received more and more attention on the information security protection of the secondary system. At present, the communication security protection of the substation adopts the boundary protection, which only coordinates with the security protection strategy of the control center, and the security protection of the equipment in the station is relatively short. This paper, starting with the analysis of the existing communication security protection technology in the substation, focuses on the protocol layer security protection technology based on the IEC 62351 standard, and puts forward the realization method of the communication transmission layer, the application layer and the link layer on the automation equipment in substation. Finally, the paper analyzes the application requirements of substation communication security protection, and puts forward the reasonable use of these security protection technology according to the urgency of the security risks and actual condition of the substation, then further enhances the level of substation communication security.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction Method for Distribution Network Outage Based on Feature Selection and Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, a fault level prediction method for distribution network based on feature selection and ensemble learning is proposed to solve the problem of high, redundant and low accuracy rate of level prediction in power distribution network. First, by preprocessing the fault data of the distribution network, the 23 kinds of initial fault features for distribution networks involving weather, load and equipment are summed up, and a new method of fault grade division for distribution network is proposed. Combined with grey relational analysis, a fault feature selection method which improves the characteristic that Relief-F algorithm can't eliminate redundancy is proposed. Finally, a strong classifier is used to predict the fault level for distribution network based on support vector machine improved by ensemble learning. Then, the proposed method is compared with the other feature selection and prediction methods. Through the actual example analysis, it is verified that the proposed method can effectively improve the prediction accuracy of distribution network fault, and has practical application value.

articleTitle: How to Measure the Performance of Automated Program Repair
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As with the advance of automated program repair, many novel repair approaches have been proposed in recent. There also exist empirical work focusing on the performance comparison among those approaches. In this paper we survey recent repair work in five main venues, and plan to answer the question of how to measure the performance of automated program repair in term of evaluation metrics. We summary the evaluation metrics in literature, and conduct the discussion on how to construct the common metrics for further research in the area of automated program repair.

articleTitle: The Improved CESSC Algorithm Based on Meanshift Sparse Subspace Clustering for Hyperspectral Images
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Hyperspectral images are rich in spatial information and spectral information. And hyperspectral image (HSI) clustering is very important for the study of HSI. However, just like all pixel-based clustering methods, traditional sparse subspace clustering(SSC) algorithm also faces these problems: (1) the effect of salt-and-pepper noise on the experimental results is more prominent; (2) it can not make full use of the different neighborhood relationships; (3) it result in high computational complexity. In this paper, we have improved the Cosine-Euclidean similarity matrix(abbreviated as CE) Construction Based on Sparse Subspace Clustering(CESSC) algorithm for Hyperspectral images to solve these three problems. First of all, we use the Meanshift algorithm to segment the original hyperspectral data, so, we get a series of regions and use the mass center of each region to represent all points in this region, then, the algorithm of Cosine-Euclidean Similarity Matrix Construction Based on Sparse Subspace Clustering is conducted on all this center of mass to get clustering labels; finally the else points in each region obtain their final clustering result by giving the same labels with their center of mass. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can improve the recognition accuracy to some extent.

articleTitle: Location and Identification Method for Low Frequency Oscillation Source Considering Control Devices of Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Negative damping oscillation and forced power oscillation are two typical kinds of low frequency oscillation (LFO). The control devices of the generator including the governor and the exciter are the main source of oscillation, which have essential differences to cause LFO. Thus locating and identifying the source of LFO correctly is of great importance to the adoption of reasonable suppression methods and improvement of system stability. This paper presents a method to locate and identify the LFO sources based on the contribution of the generator control devices to the system damping and the phase shift characteristics of the forced disturbance source. Firstly, based on the study of the generator control devices, the general rules of the electric parameters response of two kinds of oscillation are extracted. Then the criteria of LFO source location and identification is presented. And according to the principle of the location and identification criteria, the calculation method of the criterion index based on empirical mode decomposition EMD algorithm is proposed. Finally, the oscillation source location and identification method flow is made to realize the location and analysis of the oscillation sources. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by practical examples.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Guidance and Control for Cooperative Distributed Multiple Flying Objects
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this study, aiming at the problem of cooperative target pursuit by multiple flying objects, a cooperative control strategy for distributed multiple flying objects based on integrated guidance and control (IGC) is proposed. First, based on the pitch channel of the flying objects, the "leader" IGC model of the flying objects is established. The extended state observer (ESO) is designed to estimate the unknown disturbances in the model, and the self-adaptive dynamic surface sliding mode control law is applied to design the "leader" controller. Further, the distributed network mode based on the "leader-follower" relationship is applied to design the cooperative control strategy of multiple flying objects to obtain the flying objects' velocity in two directions of the pitch channel, which is transformed into the total velocity of the flying objects and trajectory inclination angle order through kinematics. Finally, the ESO and the controller of the "follower" flying object that is designed by dynamic surface sliding mode control are applied. The simulation results of two different communication topologies verify the effectiveness of the designed distributed cooperative IGC algorithm for multiple flying objects.

Author Keywords: extended state observer, integrated guidance and control, self adaptive dynamic surface sliding mode, distributed network, cooperative control strategy

articleTitle: The Electricity Sales Forecasting Based on Leading Analysis and Factor Compensation
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Electricity sales forecasting is a fundamental work for State Grid Corporation of China. Currently, after data preprocessing, X13 seasonal adjustment is applied to decompose electricity sales series into trend, season and random items. The decomposed items are predicted respectively to produce accurate forecasting results. On the basis of it, a new electricity sales forecasting method based on leading analysis and factor compensation is proposed in this paper. First of all, the leading factors are introduced to improve the ability in identifying sudden change of trend item. Then, the impact of the Spring Festival in random item is eliminated and the prediction of random item is categorized into normal month and abnormal month. Under normal month, the random item is forecasted by combining Mixture of Experts model with factor data and processed by Kalman Filter; under abnormal month, the prediction results are obtained by the method of factor elimination and compensation. Finally, combined with the impact of the Spring Festival, the adjustment of electricity sales forecasting result on January to March is achieved. The actual validation shows that the prediction accuracy and robustness of the proposed model is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Prospect of Photovoltaic System Safety Monitoring and Fault Diagnosis Technology Based on PV Cloud Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of solar energy, effective safety monitoring and fault diagnosis technologies for photovoltaic generation system are urgently needed. According to the collected local station data, traditional technologies still have some deficiencies in fault diagnosis and fault location. In this paper, the safety monitoring and fault diagnosis technology based on the photovoltaic cloud data platform is put forward, which will increase the safety, stability and economic operation level of photovoltaic power plants. The advantages of the proposed technologies are prospected as well. The photovoltaic cloud data based method will be an important development trend for safety monitoring and fault diagnosis of photovoltaic power plants.

articleTitle: Simulation and Evaluation of Voltage Sag in Distribution Network with High Permeability Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Voltage sag simulation and evaluation results is a very necessary scientific basis for electric power department and users of quantitative investment cost / benefit analysis, scheme comparison and reducing power quality hazards measures in the stage of planning and operation. In this paper, the simulation and evaluation of voltage sags in distribution networks with distributed generations is presented. The influence of different types of distributed generations on voltage sags is studied. A novel voltage sag simulation and evaluation method in smart distribution network with distributed generations has been proposed based on Point Estimation Method (PEM). By establishing the stochastic model of fault information and the power stochastic model of distributed generations outputting, the random probability problem in voltage sag simulation is transformed into multiple deterministic problems. Through computing the mean, the standard deviation and the third central moment of each node in distribution network, the voltage sag System Average Root Mean Square Variation Frequency Index (SARFI) can be computed. The simulation and evaluation of voltage sags are also completed. Experiments have been made on a test case with two different types of distributed generations, and the validity of the algorithm is proved.

articleTitle: Event Triggered Control for Leader Following Consensus of Nonlinear Multi Agent Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This technical note is concerned with the leader following consensus problem for networked Lipschitz nonlinear multi-agent systems subject to undirected communication topology. We propose an event triggered strategy with the state-dependent triggering function to solve the problem. A distinct feature of this strategy is that the communication does not occur continuously in both controller updates and triggering condition monitoring. Next, by using matrix theory and appropriate Lyapunov techniques it is proved that the leader following consensus can be reached without exhibiting Zeno behavior. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is confirmed by numerical simulation example.

Author Keywords: multi agent systems, Lipschitz nonlinear dynamics, leader following consensus, distributed event triggered, State dependent threshold

articleTitle: Relay Station Planning Algorithm to Avoid Network Congestion for PLC Network
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the characteristics of easy deployment and low cost, PLC has good prospects in carrying broadband access services in smart grid. For the constraints of channel environment, PLC needs to use relay network to ensure reliability and real-time. Based on the idea of congestion control, this paper proposes a relay station planning algorithm to reduce the possibility of PLC network congestion, while ensuring the network reliability and fulfilling the delay requirements. With the consideration of the network reliability, N-1 principle and packet loss rate, a relay station planning model based on minimum average delay and packet loss rate is constructed and solved with the immune algorithm. Simulation results show that our algorithm can achieve higher network reliability and lower congestion probability, and improve overall network performance.

articleTitle: Polymerization Methods of Systems-of-Systems Integration Effect Based on Choquet Integral
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Systems-of-systems integration is an important aspect of systems-of-systems and it's engineering research. It is comprehensive expression of overall emergent property and overall optimization property of systems-of-systems. Integration effect is measurement of systems-of-systems integration process. Systems-of-systems integration activities have strong randomness, which decides that systems-of-systems integration effect polymerization has strong non-linear additivity, making evaluation polymerization of systems-of-systems integration effect difficult. Systems-of-systems integration activity characteristics are analyzed from information integration, function integration, business process integration in the Paper firstly to establish evaluation index system of systems-of-systems integration effect; secondly, analytic hierarchy process method is adopted to establish weight vector among evaluation index system level of integration effect; then, basic set-valued random variable not only can describe random nature of development of things, but also can describe uncertainty of development state of things, and Choquet integral is a non-additive and non-linear integral based on fuzzy measurement, polymerization methods of systems-of-systems integration effect based on Choquet integral are proposed. Finally, cases are adopted to illustrate effectiveness of methods in the Paper.

Author Keywords: systems-of-systems, integration effect, index system, polymerization, evaluation

articleTitle: Risk Balancing Routing Assignment Mechanism Based on Service Importance
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The power communication network service plays an important role in the production and operation of the power system. Therefore, the power communication department needs to solve the problem that how to reduce the security risk of the bearer service and distribute the service path properly. However, most of the existing algorithms do not take the difference of service importance into account, thus resulting in unbalanced traffic channel segment distribution and increase of the overall network risk. In this paper, a risk balancing routing assignment mechanism based power communication network service importance (SIRBRM) is proposed. And the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is introduced and a model of risk balancing routing assignment problem is established. Then the routing decision based on the principle of maximum and minimum fairness constraint can choose the optimal route for the service. Finally, the simulation is carried out based on the power communication network topological data of a certain prefecture-level city. Simulation results show that compared with the other two methods, the SIRBRM can effectively reduce the link risk and the overall network risk, make the service distribution more uniform, and reduce the operational risk caused by excessive concentration of the service on some specific links. SIRBRM has broad application prospects in the existing routing optimization and future arrangements for new business methods.

articleTitle: Research on Time Synchronization Technology for Wide-Area Measurement in the Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a novel hybrid time synchronization architecture for the distribution network with limited communication resources. Firstly, the synchronization architecture is based on the Wireless Networks for Industrial Automation (WIA) and IEEE-1588 protocols. Based on this architecture, the time synchronization problem of the entire network for the large scale deployment of PMU in complex distribution network can be solved. Furthermore, focusing on the wide-area measurement demand of distribution network, a time synchronization mechanism for WIA wireless network is designed, and then the composition and operation principle of the WIA-and-IEEE-1588-based hybrid time synchronization architecture is introduced. The experimental results have verified the feasibility of the scheme.

articleTitle: Mining Information Search Pattern on Website: A Case Study of Educational Institution
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The increasing amount of internet usage encourages organizations, companies, and other institutions to engage with the public through various online media. Website is an example of online information channel for those institutions, enabling the visitors to search detailed information. Extracting pattern of website visitors' behavior is important to find out the trend on information searching and page accessing. Thus, the website can be improved to have better accessibility and user performance. However, the extracting pattern in an educational website is not often conducted while an educational website is considered as useful. This study was conducted using pattern mining, one of the applications of web usage mining, to find out patterns and trend of visitors' behavior in information searching through educational institution website. In this study, visitors' web log data of the website in February, March, and April was processed using the FP-Growth algorithm of association rules and compared as those three months have the highest number of visitors' activities in accessing website information in a year. The results show that there are seven similar patterns among the three months. However, there are some distinctive patterns found which describe the visitors' behavior each month which may occur due to the selection process agenda. By knowing these patterns, an educational institution may improve the interface and the quality of the website by creating link recommendation for each tab views which has the higher correlation to make the visitors access the information easier.

articleTitle: Simulation Design of Air Defense Forces Operation Action Supported by Space Information
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at air defense forces operation supported by space information, the paper designs the simulation of air defense forces operation supported by reconnaissance information, early warning information, communication information, navigation and orientation information, and weather information. The paper lays the foundation of simulation research on air defense forces operation supported by space information.

articleTitle: Arteriosclerosis Diagnosis Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we describe a new method for diagnosing arteriosclerotic disease using photoplethysmogram (PPG) signal. In this method, three types of characteristic parameters are used, including waveform parameters in the time domain, harmonic amplitudes in the frequency domain, and wavelet energy characteristics. Among these characteristic parameters, we have selected some features that are more favorable for the diagnosis of arteriosclerosis based on genetic algorithms. The support vector machine (SVM) model is used to fuse these parameters to establish a non-invasive arterial sclerosis recognition model. The results show that the accuracy of our algorithm on the test set is not less than 98%, and the accuracy rate on the training set reaches 100.0%. The new algorithm is accurate and convenient, and has a strong practical application potential.

articleTitle: Passivity Analysis for Neural Networks of Neutral Type with Markovian Jumping Parameters and Time-Varying Delay
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, the passivity problem is investigated for neural networks of neutral type with Markovian jumping parameters and time-varying delay. By applying novel Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional, using reciprocal convex combination method and improved free-matrix-based integral inequality, the delay-dependent criterion for the passivity of the addressed neural networks is established in terms of linear matrix inequalities(LMIs), which can be checked numerically using the effective LMI toolbox in MATLAB. An example with simulations is given to show the effectiveness and less conservatism of the proposed criterion.

articleTitle: Modelling and Simulation of Vascular Tissue Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the development of virtual reality, virtual surgery becomes a promising cross-border technology. Soft tissue modeling is one of the core problems in virtual surgery. To achieve accuracy and real-time performance at the same time, we optimize the traditional Finite element method for vascular tissue modeling. Based on the analysis of soft tissue biomechanical properties, we abstract the vascular tissue as Mooney-Rivlin material, and give the parameters according to real vascular characteristics. We build both straight and bend vascular tissue models. The BFGS method is used to improve the efficiency, and the FPS is improved by 22.21Hz than that of mesh-free method. Experimental results show that both the accuracy and the real-time performance can satisfy the need of VR surgery and have improved a lot compared with existing methods, demonstrating the validity and applicability of our method.

Author Keywords: Soft tissue deformation, Finite element method, Dynamic simulation

articleTitle: System Design and Experimental Research of Lower Esophageal Sphincter Manometry Based on Balloon Catheter
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Lower esophageal sphincter (LES) manometry provides a promised assessment of the cause of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD). In this paper, a balloon LES manometry system was designed for measuring the LES pressure (LESP) by using a balloon catheter. The balloon LES manometry system is composed of a balloon dilation catheter, a pressure detecting and recording module, and an automatic pull-through module. The forces of LES are applied to the air-filled balloon and the air pressure change is detected by an external pressure sensor. The pressure data obtained by the pressure detecting and recording module is shown and recorded within the LabVIEW platform. An automatic pull-through module was designed to replace the traditional manual pull-through method for the convenience of the operator and decreasing the hand fatigue. Six bench testing results demonstrated a high linearity (r≥;0.99) of the system with a sensitivity of 1.028 mmHg response per 1kPa of the applied pressure. The repeatability error was 4.82% and a resolution of 0.75mmHg. Also, the experiments were applied on five rabbits. The LES pressure measured by the proposed LES manometry system achieved good linear correlation (r=0.975) with the pressure measured by a commercial water-perfused catheter manometry system. In conclusion, the proposed LES manometry system is suitable for LES manometry and has the advantages of low cost and small size.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Subsea Manifold Piping Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Based on the sea depth of 1,500 m in the South China Sea, this paper focuses on the overall design ideas and methods of subsea manifolds with double flow line and double input. The layout scheme of different valves and pipelines and the space volume utilization were discussed, and the pipeline parameter design of the two phase fluid was completed. In this paper, three kinds of stress design criteria were analyzed. Stress analysis and deformation analysis of the designed piping system were carried out based on AutoPIPE software. The strength of the system was checked according to the relevant specifications of ASME. The results show that the circumferential stress was mainly affected by the internal and external pressure difference of the pipeline, and the longitudinal stress was mainly affected by the constraint form of the pipeline node and the temperature difference inside and outside the pipeline.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Carrier Landing Runway Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a new design scheme of carrier runway simulation system. The system can be used for simulating training for the aircraft of carrier landing, and it can provide pilots with an environment being closer to the actual landing. The carrier runway simulation system mainly includes runway motion simulation system and the ideal landing point simulation system. The simulation system of ideal landing point simulates the height variation of the ideal landing point by using the horizontal variation of optical virtual arresting cable, it can offer crucial movement information to the carrier aircraft pilot. The runway motion simulation system employs a programmable multi-axis controller to control the linear motion guides moving with the infrared cooperative targets, which can simulate the carrier runway movement. And the high-precision magnetic grid measurement sensor collects motion information and transfers the information into the computer. In this paper, an 8:1 scale experiment has been designed and the runway motion simulation system is implemented. The experiment results show that the maximum height error of the targets between actual and setting motion is 0.02m, which meets the requirement of the simulation system and verifies the feasibility of the runway motion simulation system. What's more, the simulation system is beneficial to the later research work of carrier-based aircraft landing ground simulation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Virtual Service System of Electric Vehicle Time-Sharing Rental Based on Multi-Agent Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Electric vehicle time-sharing rental is a new type of urban transportation plan, which can effectively improve the utilization rate of vehicles and relieve new problems such as parking difficulty in urban development. However, it is hard to simulate the pre-operation process before putting electric vehicles and charging spots into operation officially, and verify rationality of the related data settings such as vehicle rental expense, electric vehicle number, rental site number. Therefore, the virtual service system of electric vehicle time-sharing rental based on multi-agent technology is presented in this paper, which can be used to consider more complex situation of users' range anxiety and accidental failure, temperature effects, road condition effects, and so on. Moreover, based on simulation data, the load capacity and financial accounting can be predicted, which lays a solid foundation for the study of the economical operation of urban electric vehicle time-sharing system.

Author Keywords: time-sharing rental, virtual service system, multi-agent technology

articleTitle: Text Categorization by Weighted Features
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Text representation, which represent texts of variable lengths into feature vectors, is a fundamental task in machine learning. Early approaches extract lexical and syntactic features, which are discrete and sparse and can hardly capture the semantic relatedness between words. Recent advances in deep learning, which represents text segments into dense and continuous vectors, has shed light on this problem. However, the main limitation is they are usually based on complex neural network structure, which are resource-consuming to train and make inference. To remedy this, we propose a novel text representation approach which considers word local and global importance via the BM25 weighing schema. We use word vectors pretrained from large text corpus to capture the latent semantic relatedness between words. Experimental results show that our approach is effective and efficient compared with existing feature-based, unsupervised and supervised baselines.

articleTitle: The Influence of the Position of the D Plate for the Hydraulic Pulper on the Internal Flow Field
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: D-type hydraulic pulper is one of the most commonly used equipment in the pulping industry. It is mainly used to disintegrate recycled pulp such as OCC paper. In order to study the distribution of the flow field during operation of the D-type hydraulic pulper, this paper aims at the different D-plate positions and the first-six modes of the D-type hydraulic pulper. With the use of finite element analysis software FULENT and ANSYS, the flow field and modes were analyzed to obtain maps, such as speed cloud maps, waste paper speed cloud maps and waste paper volume fraction cloud maps. The effect of D plate position on the distribution of its internal flow field was studied.

articleTitle: Predicting Model about Next Crime of Serial Offender
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to predict the next crime site, we assume that the choice of target of the offender depends only on distance and geographical characteristics. Then a new prediction model is established, which starts with a clear anchor point. Therefore, we can provide law enforcement personnel with criminal predictions.

articleTitle: A Feasible Method of Virtual Flow Field Simulation - Part I: An Interface from Fluent to RTT
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Dassault Systèmes' RTT system is a real-time virtual reality one that can achieve a virtual flow field simulation. However, the relative module is not only expensive, but also not satisfied in openness. A novel and feasible method is presented here to realize three-dimensional virtual streamlines based on RTT system without using the relative module in RTT system. An interface system, CFD-RTT, has been also prototyped. Some algorithms have been investigated and applied in it such as streamline generation and arrangement and IGES exchange file. It uses an adaptive step method for generating a streamline through ANSYS Fluent simulation data. Three ways for the streamline arrangement are proposed such as evenly spacing, automatically spacing and interactively spacing according to the features of global or local flow field. The streamlines are imported into Autodesk Alias Automotive system via an IGES file, and then applied the appropriate streamline type, and integrated with the vehicle model, which is used for the simulation in Fluent. The streamlines and the vehicle model are then imported into RTT system via a wire file for simulation in a virtual reality environment.

articleTitle: Effect of Wind Gradient on the Nonlinear Dynamic Properties of Galloping of Iced Ultra-High-Voltage Long-Span Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Study on wind-induced vibration of long-span overhead transmission lines were among the most important subjects in Ultra-High-Voltage (UHV) power transmission projects. Comparing with Extreme-High-Voltage (EHV) and other voltage level lines, UHV long-span overhead transmission lines had suffered more special influence from wind gradient because of height requirements of waterway, structure of selected types of conductors and other factors. In this paper, functions of wind speed changed with both line coordinates and normal displacement was induced to establish three-freedom nonlinear dynamic equations, which described icing galloping of this type of lines more exactly. Considering actual structure and working condition of UHV long-span overhead transmission lines, this paper revealed the local bifurcation behavior and other dynamic characteristics of this model. The results showed that influence of wind gradient on the nonlinear dynamics of galloping of iced UHV long-span overhead transmission lines should not be neglected.

Author Keywords: wind gradient, long-span transmission lines, ultra-high voltage, galloping, nonlinear dynamics

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Control for Consensus of Delayed Multi-Agent Systems with Randomly Occurring Nonlinearities and Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper is mainly concerned about the leaderfollowing consensus problem of delayed multi-agent systems with randomly occurring nonlinearities and randomly occurring uncertainties via the event-triggered control. Moreover, considering time delays in multi-agent systems and noises are of practical significance. For each agent, the control actuation update is decided by the proposed event-triggered protocol and only triggered at their own event times. Based on Lyapunov stability theory and the linear matrix inequalities method, sufficient conditions are derived to guarantee all follower agents asymptotically reach the state of leader. Finally, numerical simulations are presented to verify the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of "Contribution" Attribution of Multiple Source Attribute of Power Supply Quality Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Voltage sag has gradually become one of the most important power quality problems with more and more sensitive devices being put into operation. Aiming at the causation attribute of power supply problem, this paper puts forward the "contribution degree" ranking method. First, calculating the weight of multi-source causation and establish the 3 level causation system based on AHP. Secondly, combined with the actual engineering data, analyzing the voltage sag under multi-source attributes. Finally, the severity of the equipment will be calculated based on the index of equipment incompatibility. Combining the weight analysis of the multiple source attribution and the temporary severity of the equipment under the multi source attribution, the "contribution degree" of the multi source attribution based on the incompatibility of the electrical equipment can be obtained.

articleTitle: Extending Personal Computer Storages for Improved Access over Web Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: At present, sharing of files and other media is a common use case which involves cloud storage services. However, the privacy of cloud services has become questionable as certain free cloud service providers use personal content for analytical purposes. Also, in order to share content over cloud storages, local files must be uploaded to cloud services, even for minor use cases such as directory browsing. This paper presents a novel solution which provides similar sharing capabilities to that of existing cloud services without having to store content in a cloud storage. The solution enables direct content browsing, uploading and downloading using a web interface. The solution also provides the capability to generate links for locally stored content in desktop or personal computers. The presented solution utilizes peer-to-peer networking technologies which are scalable and more secure. Furthermore, the performance measures indicate competitive results in comparison with existing cloud service providers for content sharing.

articleTitle: Frequency Offset Insensitive Multiple Symbol Differential Detection Scheme for IEEE 802.15.4 BPSK Receivers
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A simple frequency offset insensitive multiple-symbol differential detection (MSDD) scheme is proposed for IEEE 802.15.4 binary phase shift keying (BPSK) receivers. The detection is initiated by estimating and compensating the carrier frequency offset (CFO) effect in the chip sample. With these compensated statistics, the decisions are jointly made by allowing the observation window length to be longer than two bit intervals. Simulation results demonstrate that, at packet error rate (PER) of 1×10^-3, the chip signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) gap between the ideal coherent detection (perfect carrier reference phase and no CFO) with differential decoding and conventional optimal single differential coherent detection (SDCD) is filled by 2.1 dB when the observation window length is set to be 6 bit intervals. Namely, detection reliability of the present IEEE 802.15.4 BPSK receivers is significantly improved. Then, the benefit that less energy consumed by retransmissions is successfully achieved.

Author Keywords: Multiple symbol differential detection, First-order differential modulation, Frequency offset estimation and compensation, IEEE 802.15.4 BPSK receiver

articleTitle: Tongue Image Segmentation Based on the Sub-Block Region Growing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Segmentation of the tongue area in the tongue image is the basis of the informatization and objectification for the tongue diagnosis. Based on the color features and intensity characteristics of the tongue image, a tongue image segmentation method based on the sub-block region growing algorithm is proposed. The tongue image is transformed from the RGB color space to the HIS color space. According to the seed points selected by the user, the hue and intensity characteristics of the adjacent sub-blocks are analyzed. Then the criteria for sub-block merging in the area are calculated, and all the sub-blocks that meet the criteria are merged. Then the sub-blocks grow and merge again in a smaller size until no more sub-blocks meet the criterion. The experimental results show that the algorithm can effectively segment the tongue image area.

articleTitle: Recognition Effects of Deep Convolutional Neural Network on Smudged Handwritten Digits
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Deep convolutional neural network (CNN) is known to be the first truly successful deep learning approach for image processing and understanding, e.g., the handwritten digits discrimination. However, in real applications such as handwritten zip code recognition, the collected images are commonly with smudged background. In this paper, we study the recognition effects of CNN on smudged digits and compared the results with three-layered perceptron. Experimental results based on MNIST dataset with smudged background (simulated by salt-and-pepper and gaussian noises) show that a drastic decline of recognition accuracy is observed for CNN, suggesting that the extracted features by convolutional operation and max pooling is very sensitive to the noise.

articleTitle: A General Modeling Framework of Combat-Oriented Communication Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As a carrier and transmission channel of information, the communication system is a sub-part of the combat simulation system. The modeling of communication systems is an important part of the combat simulation process. In view of the deficiencies in the existing modeling and simulation of communication systems, the model architecture of military communication systems in combat simulation is presented in this paper. Its composition and function are described. A general modeling framework for oriented-combat communication simulation system is proposed and the corresponding implementation of the modeling framework is given. The general modeling framework can effectively support the construction and application of communication systems in combat simulation, and has good scalability and flexibility.

Author Keywords: combat simulation, communication system, model architecture, general modeling framework

articleTitle: Guaranteed Cost Finite-Time Control of Uncertain Discrete-Time Positive Switched Systems with Time Delay
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper considers the guaranteed cost finitetime stability of uncertain discrete-time positive switched systems with time delay. Firstly, the definition of guaranteed cost finite-time stability is introduced. By using the multiple linear co-positive Lyapunov function (MLCLF) and average dwell time(ADT) approach, a state feedback controller is designed and sufficient conditions are obtained to guarantee the corresponding closed-loop system is guaranteed cost finitetime stability(GCFTS). Such conditions can be solved by linear programming. Finally, a numerical example is provided to show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Information Extraction in Frequency Domain Based on Entropy Theory and Genetic Algorithm in Near-Infrared Spectra
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to efficiently extract the analyte information in near infrared (NIR) spectra, a new algorithm, which is named as GA-FD-SEL, was proposed by signal processing in frequency domain. At first, to take advantages of multiscale property of NIR spectra, wavelet packet transform (WPT) algorithm was adopted to split the raw spectra into a series of frequency components in wavelet domain. The optimum decomposition level was determined based on the entropy contribution of each components. Then the set of WPT components was initially selected according to entropy contribution again, and further selected using genetic algorithm (GA). At last, based on the set of filtered-components, the multivariate regression models were built using the partial least squares (PLS) regression method. To validate the GA-FD-SEL algorithm, it was applied to construct the prediction model for measuring the oil content of corn. Experimental results showed that the GA-FD-SEL algorithm can greatly improve the prediction ability of NIR regression models and the prediction errors could decrease by up to 50.2%, indicating that it could efficient find the useful WPT components where analyte information resides.

articleTitle: Research on Space Pose and Hydraulic System Stability of Remote-Controlled Demolition Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The natural frequency of loaded hydraulic cylinder is an important factor that affects the dynamic characteristics and stability of the system. In this paper, the mathematical model of the hydraulic valve controlled cylinder system is established by taking the base arm and the end arm of the remote-controlled demolition robot as an example. Based on the kinetic energy principle, the estimation formula between the equivalent mass of the hydraulic cylinder and the rotation angle of the manipulator is given, and the extreme range of the equivalent mass inferred from the natural frequency of the cylinder is analyzed. Through experiments on the frequency characteristics of the remote-controlled demolition robot, it has proven that the estimation formula of the equivalent mass proposed in this paper is effective. This method can be used in the engineering design of the stability and dynamic characteristics of serial manipulator's hydraulic system of the remote-controlled demolition robot.

articleTitle: Tracing Coding Behavior Patterns by Function-Calling Features of Code
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Protean malware mutations and premeditated cyber attacks are threatening security of information systems worldwide. There is an urgent need for effective methods to trace the source of code. In this paper, through study of coding behavior, which is a social characteristic of code, we trace the source of code preliminarily. Based on function-calling relation graph, three function-calling features of code are proposed to distinguish different coding patterns of programmers: relative edit distance shows the orderliness of code, semivariogram reveals programmers' coding logic (Breadth First Coding or Depth First Coding) and ODD value suggests different function arrangement styles. Tested in experiments, these features are able to trace the coding behavior patterns of programmers, providing assistance with source tracing as expected.

articleTitle: Pulmonary Nodule Classification and Recognition Based on Sparse Representation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Classification and identification of pulmonary nodules is a key link in computer-aided diagnosis of lung tumors. However, the key problem in the classification and identification of pulmonary nodules is how to extract comprehensive and effective features. In response to this problem, this paper presents a classification and identification of pulmonary nodules based on sparse representation algorithm. The method is based on the lung nodule LIDC standard database to extract the texture features of nodules, Then, the multi-slice ROI feature of the same nodule is selected as the data set, but the data disaster is caused. However, the sparse representation can effectively reduce the large amount of redundant data and make the feature information more comprehensive and effective. Experimental results show that, while ensuring efficiency, the proposed method can effectively improve the classification accuracy of pulmonary nodules, and then assist doctors in clinical diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research and Construction of Semantic Retrieval Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper is to gain an overall view of the current research status of semantic retrieval systems based on knowledge graph, and construct such a system of rice field. The authors selected several well-known semantic retrieval models of various industries, such as Google, Bing, Elsevier, Baidu ZhiXin, etc., and comprehensively analyzed them from the aspects of entity type, field, entity source, retrieval mode, and information presentation, and then proposed a semantic retrieval system on basis of ontology, knowledge graph and nature language processing with multi-source of rice. The survey result shows that semantic retrieval is stepping toward the multi-field and instantiation stably, and the future research is concerned with semantization depth and multi-field knowledge graph. The proposed system can provide services of entity and knowledge retrieval, visual navigation and analysis, which meet users' retrieval needs in semantic to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Safety Evaluation of Personal Injury and Death in Lifting Operation Based on Accident Tree Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to analyze and evaluate safety of hoisting operation system, we need to analyze the reason of accident inducing mechanism, to find the influence factors of deep layers until subdivide the basic event. Through determining the logical relationship between each other, a lifting heavy fall accident tree is established. On the basis of the analysis of the minimum cut set, the Delphi method is used to give empirical estimation of the occurrence probability of these basic events, and then determine the influencing factors of the top event. On this basis, the contribution of the basic events to the top events is revealed through the sensitivity analysis. The research results show that we can control people's accidents from the aspects of human unsafe behavior, insecurity of somethings, management defects and safety technical countermeasures.

articleTitle: Improved FMAC Based Adaptive Neural Power System Stabilizer for a DFIG
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: An adaptive neural power system stabilizer (ANPSS) based on the improved flux magnitude and angle control (IFMAC) was proposed to control a double fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind turbine. Firstly, the dynamic of DFIG including the transient dynamic of rotor and stator was theoretically analyzed, and based on which, the IFMAC strategy was also given and analyzed. Secondly, based on which, an ELAMN artificial neural network (ANN) was used to stabilize oscillations of DFIGs during various disturbances, where the classical back-propagation (BP) algorithm was introduced to train the ANN online for adaptive purpose, and the Jacobian Matrix was replaced by its sign to reduce the computational burden. The comparative results show that the proposed ANPSS worked with the IFMAC together can enhance system damping and improve power system transient stability.

articleTitle: Mixed Tensor Product of q-Bezier-Poisson Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a generalization of mixed tensor product of Bernstein-Poisson basis functions based on q-integers and discuss some important properties of these bases, such as interpolation, differentiation, unimodality, integration, degree reduction, degree elevation and so on. We also obtain some basic properties of the mixed tensor product of q-Bézier-Poisson surfaces. Our results generalize the conclusions of Bernstein-Poisson bases and and Bézier-Poisson surfaces, we also have more modeling flexibility by choosing the parameter q.

articleTitle: Identification of Cell Pathology by Using Stacked Auto-Encoders Combination with Rotation Forest
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Cytopathology is an effective method for obtaining pathological diagnosis in clinic. Because of its safety and convenience, it has been widely used in clinical diagnosis. The classification and recognition of cell pathology images by computer can provide effective diagnostic basis for medical personnel and improve the accuracy and efficiency of diagnosis. Therefore, it is of great significance to use the computational method to identify the pathological image of the cell. In this paper, we propose a new method to identify cell pathology images based on the depth learning algorithm. First, we standardize the processing of cell pathology images, and get images that are suitable for computer algorithm; then extract the advanced features automatically by using automatic encoders; finally use rotation forest classifier to identify the extracted features. In the experiment, we use 5-fold cross-validation method to ensure the stability of the experimental results. Excellent experimental results show that our model can effectively identify cell pathology images, and provide quantitative and objective diagnostic evidence for medical staff.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Establishing Intelligent Headlamp Model under Double-Factor Weight
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the process of establishing the model of intelligent headlamp system, the problem of safety and comfort can not be taken into account at the same time, so the idea of safety equation is put forward in the paper. According to the relationship between vehicle speed and cumulative damage, the safety equation is established. Then the relationship between security and comfortable is scientifically divided by the safety equation, the intelligent sample data are also built by it. After that, the method of online learning on the neural network is used to identify these data. The simulation results show that the recognition effect is good.

articleTitle: Wavelet Chaotic Neural Network with Function Disturbance and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Chaotic Neural Network has the dynamics property of gradient descent and chaotic at the same time by introducing self-feedback item and simulated annealing strategy. The trigonometric function disturbance was introduced into chaotic neural network and chaotic neural units with function disturbance were studied. The reversed bifurcation and the maximum Lyapunov exponent were given and the dynamic system was analyzed. Energy function was constructed by applying the unified framework theory and was proven to be asymptotically stable. The wavelet chaotic neural network was applied in the function and combinatorial optimization problems. The simulation results show that the chaotic neural network with disturbance of trigonometric function can solve function and combinatorial optimization problems effectively.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Reconstruction Optimization Method for High-Speed Flying Object Based on Multi-Granularity Matching
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A three-dimensional(3D) reconstruction method based on multi-granularity matching is proposed by borrowing the symmetry feature for the high-speed flying Object, which can obtain the image information in the flight process. Firstly, the two-dimensional contour information of the object is extracted by two high-resolution CCD camera orthogonal image system. The image segmentation technique is used to extract the two-dimensional contour information of the object; thenimproved shape from shading (SFS) algorithm to solve the relative height and surface normal vector of each point on the surface of the object; and finally the 3D morphology of the surface of the high-speed flight is reconstructed by using the image splicing optimization technique. And verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method through the three-dimensional reconstruction of the solid model.

articleTitle: A Novel Method of Detecting and Locating the Macula Based on Morphological Features Fitting
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Color retinal images have been widely used in diagnosis and screening of ophthalmic diseases. Macula detection and fovea location in retinal images are important steps in grading and diagnosis of ophthalmic diseases. However, due to the weaker reflection of the macula, it is difficult to determine the fovea accurately by the lack of clear border in the macula. An efficient method for detecting and locating macula based on morphological features fitting is proposed. The macula area is detected by its low brightness and round shape features. And then the K-means clustering and circle fitting is applied to achieve accurate position of macular center. A series of tests show good performance in the public retinal images database. Thus the proposed method based on morphological features fitting is proved to be efficient and useful for computer-aided diagnosis of ocular diseases.

articleTitle: Hybrid Traffic Identification Based on Sequential Pattern Mining
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A novel identification method based on sequential pattern mining is proposed to detect different network traffic in encrypted hybrid data. After dimensionality reduction for traffic series, the data are cut into short sequences. By sequential pattern mining and pruning, the characteristics sequential sets, which are extracted from transaction database comprised of these sequences, are used to calculated and analyzed the identification results. With removing each traffic's characteristic away from the hybrid data, the final results are verified and concluded. The experiments show that the recall and precision of identification results are more than 60%.

articleTitle: Reliability Guarantee Mechanism and Flat Communication Protocol Structure for Power System Protection Communication Networks in Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to satisfy requirements of safe and stable operations for complicated wide area power systems in Energy Internet, the concept of power system protection is proposed to fulfill high-accuracy, panoramic-awareness, multi-scene, whole-process and real-time intelligent decision for power systems. To support its function, communication network is essential. However, currently, protocol structure and reliability guarantee mechanism for power system protection communication network have not been determined. Aiming at this problem, combined with the advanced Software Defined Networks (SDN), this paper firstly proposes an evolved and flat protocol solutions for the communication network based on previous power system protection requirement. Then, reliability guarantee mechanism based on high dependability for this communication network is introduced, which includes service classification strategy, service control and service scheduling. To support above flat communication structure and reliability structure, a SDN-based flat scheduling analysis and test system is developed to verify its efficiency. Results show that the flat architecture reliability mechanism can satisfy system protection services well.

Author Keywords: Energy Internet, flat structure, power system protection, protocol structure, reliability

articleTitle: Using Information Uncertainty for Keywords Extraction in Language System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Determining and distinguishing the capability of a node is an extremely important and appealing issue in complex networks, especially in many text processing tasks. There are many factors to inuence the evaluation, such as the topology structure character, the related statistical information and the transmission mechanism of the network. However, few previous studies are considered this issue from the information uncertainty or information missing of the network system in the transmission mechanism therein. In this paper, we focus on discussing the evaluation method of the importance of the node in the language system, in order to nd a more suitable evaluation and quantized metric to accomplish a well understanding of the text from the uncertainty of the whole system point of view. For doing this, a novel metric is proposed based on entropy to evaluate the importance of a node. The experimental results on actual information retrieval demonstrate that our approach can obtain well understanding of a text.

articleTitle: A Low Cost Attitude and Heading Reference System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Real-time control should be conducted to the moving attitude during the autonomous flight of small unmanned aerial vehicle. The movement information of small unmanned aerial vehicle needed for control system is obtained through inertial measuring sensor. The information fusion algorithm can be designed through the original data obtained by this sensor so that the necessary state information can be provided for flight control system. In this paper, the design and implementation of a low cost Attitude and Heading Reference System is discussed, and the algorithm has been applied to the attitude control of small unmanned helicopter.

Author Keywords: Attitude and Heading Reference System, Kalman Filtering, Information Fusion

articleTitle: Research on Airport Safeguard Mission Planning Method Based on Discrete Event
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Airport safeguard mission planning is a complex discrete event system that requires multiple professionals, crews, and devices to work together. A set of efficient and complete safeguard methods can ensure that fighters take off and fight in the shortest time and optimal condition, which can greatly improve the combat effectiveness. In this paper, by studying the process and characteristics of airport safeguard mission, vehicle routing problem and discrete event simulation. Establishing discrete event simulation model in the process of transporting and mounting ammunition. EM-Plant simulation software is applied to simulate all the safeguard process, and the shortest time to complete transport and mount ammunition is reached, and then the optimization plan is put forward to solve the bottleneck problem.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Monitoring System for Data Center Thermal Efficiency Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Nowadays, the scale of data centers (DCs) and the density of IT equipments are showing a remarkable increase, resulting in a substantial increase in heat dissipated from racks. We propose a real-time monitoring system for data center thermal Efficiency anlysis. 3D visualization technology is introduced to implement intuitive monitoring of IT equipments. In particular, the system proposed in this paper collects comprehensive and fine-grained DC environmental state information through a wireless sensor network (WSN), wherein sensors can be flexibly deployed at various locations of racks inside the data center. In order to demonstrate the effectiveness of the system, the basic and advanced real-time thermal metrics are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: The Positioning and Anti-Swing for Crane Based on Smooth Trajectory
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: For the crane transportation, the payload inertia swing is caused by the trolley acceleration change. To achieve the objective of positioning and anti-swing, a trajectory planning method for crane based on the acceleration smooth switching is proposed in this paper. The two-dimensional crane mathematical model and the phase plane analysis method are utilized in this method. The analytic expression is obtained according to the three-segment acceleration and the acceleration smooth transition, which is applied easily. The control system is designed to reduce the direct jerk for the trolley. The precise positioning of the trolley and the payload anti-swing are taken into account. With the simulation and analysis, the trolley can reach the specified position, the payload swing is eliminated, and the jerk is reduced. Compared with the trigonometric function trajectory, the experiment results show that this method can better meet the requirements of smooth operation, positioning and anti-swing.

articleTitle: Intelligence Information Collection System of Garment Manufacturing Based on RFID
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Radio Frequency Identification automatic recognition technology (RFID) has brought new revolutionary changes to the intellectualization of garment production. In this study, the use of RFID in the information collection process of garment manufacturing was mainly described. And how to carry out automatic identification of RFID technology in clothing production and the module structure of information system was analyzed. An intelligence information collection system of clothing manufacturing based on RFID was established in order to realize the production of clothing information in real time so as to solve the problem of lag in production information transmission. It would provide an effective solution and reference for the production process to achieve transparency and production management visualization in delivery and collection.

articleTitle: Measurement of Location and Attitude for Bookstore Management Robot in Narrow Path
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper deals with the location problem for the bookstore management mobile robot in the narrow path. The objective is to study measuring approach of the point location and the attitude angle for the bookstore management mobile robot based on radio frequency identification (RFID) technology. First, the installation position of the RFID reader and writer is designed. Then, the data encoding rules of the RFID label are formulated. Finally, the measurement algorithm of the point location and the attitude angle is proposed. This location approach provides the state feedback information for the path control system of the mobile robot without increasing the hardware cost of the system, only in the robot controller to increase the location algorithm in the control software. It is especially suitable for the fixed-point target control of the library management mobile robot in the narrow path.

articleTitle: Research on a Method of Clock Synchronization of Power Users' Power Information Acquisition Terminal Based on a New Timing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the accuracy of time synchronization in power consumption information collection system is insufficient, a method of clock synchronization of power users' power information acquisition terminal based on a new timing algorithm is proposed. This paper first analyzes the traditional NTP time synchronization algorithm. In view of the shortcomings of the algorithm in clock synchronization, the channel asymmetry is fully considered and the algorithm is optimized in this paper. Also, a synchronization calculation method based on minimal round trip difference of NTP is proposed. By implementing this method in the synchronized structure of electricity info-collecting acquisition terminal clock, it can be seen that the new synchronization calculation method is largely improved in both accuracy and convergence compared with older one.

articleTitle: An Implementation Method of Interactive Operation Based on Accurate Spatial Calculation for Desktop Virtual Maintenance Training System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to focus the trainees' attention on the operation of equipment and tool rather than the specific model motions such as rotation and translation, desktop virtual training system needs to automatically recognize the purpose of the user's operations and simulate model motion in real time. This paper proposes a novel method based on spatial calculation to implement interactive operations in a user-friendly way. Not only can it automatically and accurately calculate the model motion parameters corresponding to users' operations, but also adapt to a different position and attitude of equipment, and different users operation behaviors. The method has been successfully applied in an interactive maintenance training system of actual hydroelectric generating equipment and proved to be effective.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Soil Pressure of Earth Dam with Polymer Anti-Seepage Wall
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Polymer anti-seepage wall is a new-type reinforcement method for earth dams, the study on the dynamic soil pressure of earth dam with polymer anti-seepage wall can provide reference for aseismic design of earth dams. In this paper, the distribution law of dynamic soil pressure for both earth dam with polymer anti-seepage wall and earth dam with traditional concrete anti-seepage wall under earthquake are studied by model test and numerical simulation. The results show the lateral soil pressure and vertical soil pressure of the earth dam with polymer anti-seepage wall are less than that of the earth dam with concrete anti-seepage wall and the stress concentration always occurs at the downstream edge of the dam with polymer anti-seepage wall. It is probably because the polymer anti-seepage wall can produce the coordinated deformation with the soil under the earthquake. The concrete anti-seepage wall has high stiffness and the lateral "jacking effect" surrounding it should be taken seriously. The research results in this paper provide a theoretical reference for the seismic safety of earth dam with polymer anti-seepage wall and popularization and application of new anti-seepage walls in the earthquake area.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Improving the Accuracy and Real-Time of Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents an algorithm to improve the accuracy and real-time of target tracking. The algorithm uses Gaussian mixture background model to describe the background and extract the foreground moving target. After fixed threshold processing, median filtering and morphological processing, the minimum external rectangle of the foreground moving object is calculated. By YCbCr local shadow detection, the shadow region can be detected quickly to ensure the real-time tracking of the target. CAMShift algorithm is improved to calculate 2D H-S color histogram by combining saturation component and hue component to get more accurate target search window by making full use of target color information. Finally, the target search region and the target rectangular region obtained by Gaussian mixture background model are logically "AND" calculated, and the final target tracking window is obtained. The experiment shows that this algorithm can improve the accuracy of target tracking compared with CAMShift algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation of Ground Assault System Based on Finite Synthesis Method
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Ground assault system construction is a necessary guarantee for the rapid formation of combat effectiveness. Based on the analysis of ground assault system requirements, this paper proposes an assessment method based on finite synthesis. This method effectively limits the "dimension disaster" problem caused by the aggregation of multi-level and multi-category indicators by limiting the scope and degree of comprehensive integration. In the form of capability maps, the calculation results of the equipment system are showed which are convenient for judging an equipment and decision support.

articleTitle: A Finite Element Analysis of Internal Fixations for U-Shaped Sacral Fracture
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Research Purpose: To compare the stability of sacral fracture fixation with three kinds of internal fixations by using finite element method. Proposed Methods: The L4-L5 and pelvic models were intercepted from previously established and validated complete lumbar pelvic model and modified to simulate the U-shaped sacral fracture model, and fixed using the following three fixation methods. (1) screw with S1S2 passed through, (2) L4L5 pedicle screw + screw for wing of ilium, (3) L4L5 pedicle screw + screw with S1 passed through + screw for wing of ilium. A 500N force was applied for point of action where is in central position of L4 superior end-plate and coupled with superior end-plate surface, then compared the stress, strain and fracture gap separation value of different fixation methods. Results: There is no significant difference on fracture gap separation value and strain on fracture surface in above three fixation methods, however the maximum stress (101.1MPa) produced by the first fixation method is less than the one (291.1MPa) produced by the second method and the one (197.1MPa) produced by the third fixation method. Conclusions: For U-shaped sacral fracture, the prior adoption is the first fixation method to make fix.

articleTitle: An Improved PPVO Data Hiding Scheme
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The pixel-based pixel value ordering (PPVO) which each pixel is predicted using its sorted context pixels greatly improves the embedding capacity compared with the traditional PVO algorithm. In the PPVO algorithm, the prediction value is more accurate if there is a strong correlation between the target pixel and its context pixels. Otherwise, the prediction value is inaccurate. For higher embedding capacity and image quality, an improved PPVO is proposed. In the proposed scheme, the target pixel is predicted by a specific prediction method first. Then, the predicted value is added to the context pixels as the additional pixel value. In the process of embedding data, the target pixel is predicted by using the maximum / minimum value of the context pixel vector. Experimental results demonstrate that the embedding capacity of proposed method is larger than that of PPVO. The marked image quality of proposed method is also better than that of PPVO.

Author Keywords: information security, reversible data hiding, pixel value prediction, PPVO, embedding capacity, image quality

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Modal Parameters Estimate Based on RDT – ARMA with Measured Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Large structure modal parameter estimation has always been an important research content. Its core content is to obtain the eigenvalues of large-scale structural system. Based on the environmental excitaion, to obtain high precision system free response is particularly important. This paper presents a random reduction de-noising-ARMA method(RDT-ARMA method). By analyzing the characteristics of free response root and imaginary part under the condition of health and damage, the noise modal of free response obtained by stochastic reduction method can be effectively eliminated to obtain a more realistic system free response signal. Based on this, the modal of large structural system is identified by ARMA method. And through the actual acquisition of the WSN signal processing measured acceleration, indicating the effectiveness of the proposed method can be proved.

articleTitle: Network-Based Synchronization of Mechanical Robot Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the network-based synchronization of master-slave mechanical robot systems. The framework of networked synchronization system is provided, in which both the time delay and the data packet loss in the communication channels are considered. A state feedback controller design method is proposed and the corresponding theorem in terms of linear matrix inequalities is established.
