Through solving a set of linear matrix inequalities, the controller gain can be obtained. A numerical example is used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Online Newton Step for Portfolio Selection with Side Information
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Online portfolio selection, as a research hotspot in financial signal processing, has been widely studied with machine learning perspective in recent years. Online Newton Step (ONS), which generates portfolio with low-complexity online convex optimization and achieves the same asymptotic wealth as the Best Constant-Rebalanced Portfolio in hindsight, is one promising algorithm among various portfolio selection strategies. However, ONS does not consider the downside risk, which leads to large investment loss in some market environments. To overcome this limitation, this paper proposes a novel portfolio selection method, namely ONS with Side Information (ONS-SI), which incorporates ONS with the side information derived from the market, to reduce the investment risk. The performance of ONS-SI is evaluated on the Chinese A-share market. Experiment results show that the proposed ONS-SI achieves higher wealth and lower downside risk than ONS.

articleTitle: Sequential CI Fusion Steady-State Suboptimal Kalman Filter for Multiple Time-Delay Systems with Correlated Noises
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: It is troublesome to obtain the fused state estimation for multi-sensor multi-delay systems with correlated noises. The previous conventional fused estimation method uses the information, sent by several different filter, smoothers and predictors, to get one-step estimation, which increases the complexity of the method, so that it is not suitable for real application. In order to get more convenient estimators, the augmented state equation is introduced, and then an augmented steady-state Kalman estimator can be got, which conceals the time delays. Extracting the partial component of that augmented steady-state estimator yields the suboptimal estimator, which ignores the correlation between the components of the augmented estimator, but possesses more excellent rapidity and convenience compared with the previous fused estimator. Then by Sequential Covariance Intersection (CI) fusion method, a fast fusion steady-state suboptimal Kalman filter is obtained. Simulation examples show that although the proposed fusion steady-state estimator is suboptimal, its accuracy is higher than each of the local estimators and approximate to the optimal information fusion estimator.

Author Keywords: Multi-delay system, steady-state Kalman filter, Sequential Covariance Intersection, correlated noises

articleTitle: Analysis of the Effectiveness of Generator-Network Cooperative Planning Scheme Based on Monte Carlo Simulation of Power System Refinement Scene
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Due to the advantages of simple, fast and applicability, the intelligent algorithm can be used to simulate unknown massive scenes in the future. This paper mainly introduces the medium and long-term simulation method used to evaluate the source-network collaborative development planning program. Based on the actual situation of the large-scale new energy access power system, a time series Monte Carlo simulation method is used to establish the mid-to-long term operation evaluation model. According to the known power supply planning, load conditions, and grid layout planning, input large amounts of data to simulate the operating status of the power system, and calculate the technical and economic indicators of the power supply and grid.

articleTitle: Parameters Tuning of TFM and Defect Detection of CFRP Sheet Based on Ultrasonic Array Probe
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Carbon fiber-reinforced plastics (CFRP) becomes wildly used while easily delaminated during manufacture and use, thus it is important to detect those delamination defects. This paper aims to provide an effective method to detect small delamination defects in CFRP sheets, and Total Focusing Method (TFM) holds the trend of development in the testing field. In order to improve the imaging effect, several parameters of TFM including excitation signal length, time-delay matrix, characteristic value and weight function of superimposed echo signals are analyzed and tuned, and then simulations and experiments are performed to verify the validity of the parameters tuning.

articleTitle: Scheme Evaluation of Automobile Comprehensive Performance Based on Grey Clustering Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In view of the deficiency of traditional evaluation method of automobile comprehensive performance, the mathematical optimal solution usually cannot be filtered from several schemes in engineering. This paper introduces the theory of analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and grey clustering analysis. Then seven automobile overall schemes were selected to be evaluated, while six typical performance indicators were selected as evaluation indexes. AHP was used to calculate weight coefficient of each performance index, and grey clustering method was applied to obtain the weighted order of each scheme. The case study showed that the proposed method can evaluate the automobile overall schemes effectively. Seven schemes can be put in order according to the satisfaction degree with grey classification. Thus, the analysis result is practical.

articleTitle: Resource-Aware and Cross-Layer Resource Allocation Mechanism for Power Wireless Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To solve the problem of low resource utilization in power wireless access networks and guarantee the QoS of power services effectively, a resource-aware and cross-layer resource allocation mechanism for power wireless access network is proposed. First of all, according to the characteristics of power wireless access network, a virtualized system model based on SDN is proposed. The underlying resources are virtualized and abstracted. The resources state of physical layer and the different QoS of service layer are perceived by SDN controller. Then, considering the factors of cost, network load and QoS constraints, the resource allocation model of power wireless access network is proposed. Finally, the resource-aware dynamic resource allocation algorithm is designed to solve the optimal resource allocation of wireless access network under the condition of satisfying QoS requirements. The simulation results show that the resource-aware and cross-layer resource allocation mechanism proposed in this paper improves network resource utilization and significantly improves network operation efficiency under the premise of meeting QoS requirements of power services.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Speed Control System for Test Motion Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Test motion mechanism is the core test facility in vehicle performance test field. Good stability and dynamic performance are the basic conditions for obtaining high quality test data. From the basic requirements of the test motion mechanism application, the classic engineering design method of the double closed-loop regulator combining saturation control with current limit, was used in the DC speed control system. The test motion mechanism control parameters were analyzed and calculated in detail. Besides, a common hardware system was established with verification. Establishing the complete calculation method for speed control system in this paper has guidance and reference.

articleTitle: Assessing Network Clustering Based on a Near-Realistic Model
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To assess the performance of network clustering algorithms on real networks, a near-realistic network model is constructed. It infers the ability of a network clustering algorithm to analyze real networks through its performance on model networks. To ensure rationality of this inference, the constructed model network has the same first-order statistical properties as the network under investigated. Meanwhile, the constructed model network can have any given cluster structure. An illustration example shows that the constructed model provides a way to evaluate network clustering algorithms objectively.

Author Keywords: network clustering, cluster assessment model, network topology

articleTitle: A Time-Threshold-Based Dynamic Probability Scheme for Vertical Handoff in Cellular/WLAN Interworking
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel Time-threshold-based Dynamic Probability Scheme of Voice Calls (TDPSVC) for vertical handoff in WLAN-embedded cellular networks. For the sake of reducing the Upward Vertical Handoff (UVH) call dropping probabilities and cellular call blocking probability more, proposed scheme designs a newly dynamic probability Downward Vertical Handoff (DVH) decision scheme for cellular ongoing voice calls within dual cellular/WLAN coverage area to revise the Time-threshold-based Upward Priority Scheme (TUPS). Simulation results show that the proposed scheme mitigates the channel congestion in cellular coverage area and then obviously reduces the prioritized UVH call dropping probability and non-prioritized UVH call dropping probability as well as cellular call blocking probability at the cost of minor influencing quality of service (QoS) of insensitive cellular voice calls while maintaining high cellular bandwidth utilization compared with TUPS.

articleTitle: Phased Array Ultrasonic Imaging Front-End T/R Hardware Circuit Design of Diving and Salvaging Helmet
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: During the process of salvaging and rescue in inland rivers, due to the low visibility of the underwater environment, it is difficult to observe the surrounding environment and sediments by using light vision. Based on the principle of ultrasonic imaging, combined with the needs of underwater salvage and rescue, a front-end T/R hardware circuit with 64 array elements, 32 transmit channels, and 16 ultrasonic receive channels was designed. This circuit is used as an ultrasonic signal acquisition unit in the design of subsequent diving rescue helmet. According to the diameter distribution range of common objects and salvage tools in the water area, the demand for diving distance in the near field, and attenuation law of ultrasonic distance, we can determine the center frequency of the ultrasonic transducer of the diving rescue helmet, the number of array elements focused by the phased array, and the gain compensation range of ultrasonic echo signal.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Warning of Lawn Trampling Behavior in Surveillance Video
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we present a monitoring and warning method for the lawn trampling behavior in the surveillance video. Through analyzing the surveillance video image in detail, a background model is established at first. Then the lawn area in the video is determined and the background difference method is used to detect and extract the motion target. Then, according to the positional relationship and the overlap area of the lawn area and the moving target, whether the pedestrian has trampled the lawn is judged. When lawn trampling behavior has happened, the monitoring information will be displayed on the screen of the monitoring video in time and a warning sound will be issued. Experiments show that the method can extract the moving target framework clearly and can detect the human lawn trampling behavior and alert them in time. The method also has good real-time performance.

articleTitle: The Application of Deep Neural Network in Speech Enhancement Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To solve the problem that Non-stationary noise is difficult to remove during speech enhancement process when using Fourier transform, this essay will put forward a speech enhancement algorithm based on the combination of Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition (EEMD) and Deep Neural Network (DNN). Firstly, preprocessing the original signal by EEMD, and decomposing a series of time-frequency information of the IMF component to meet the time-variation requirement better; Secondly, adjusting the weight of the IMF component by DNN and then synthesize it to enhanced the speech; Finally, comparing the differences of speech enhancement performance between using EEMD alone, using Fourier transform and EEMD as a preprocessing. The results show that the enhanced algorithm using EEMD as a preprocessing improves the scores of PESQ and STOI by 0.745 and 0.169 respectively, effectively improving the speech quality and intelligibility.

articleTitle: Optimization Based Mono-Visual Inertial Odometry
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Visual-inertial odometry has exerted a variety of promising applications in the robotics and computer vision society due to their complementary nature in terms of both accuracy and quick response. This paper presents a novel odometry approach using monocular camera measurements and inertial cues. It is formulated within a probabilistic framework that considers both visual landmark reprojection errors and inertial statistical properties. Unlike the traditional optimization based methods, ours takes the inertial cues in the propagation step, rather than incorporates them in the cost function, with the aim of reducing the system computational burdens. The inertial estimates are then fed into the cost function pose part and visual feature matching part. Additionally, to bootstrap the camera sparsity and shorten the computational time, merely the keyframe lankmarks are selected and the less informative states are marginalized in the objective function. The experiments show that our approach presents competitive outcomes in terms of both accuracy and robustness

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multidimensional Display Power Market Configuration Graphics System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In view of the present situation that the human-computer interface of the Power Market Operation System is mainly dependent on the software customization development, a configuration graphics system is proposed and implemented to meet the needs of multi-time, multi-dimension and flexible display of trading business. In this paper, a hierarchical structure of transaction configuration graph based on SOA design is proposed, the role of each layer in the architecture and its implementation are also discussed. A definition and implementation method of configuration primitive based on an event-property-binding mechanism is described in detail. It can freely switch over a variety of transaction related dimensions including "time" through the screen interaction. The transaction configuration graphics software provides the ability of transaction graphics system to quickly generate business graph-interface. It reduces the difficulty of system development and maintenance, and it enhances the flexibility of graphics to display multidimensional transaction data.

Author Keywords: Power Market Operation System, configuration graphics system, multi-time and multidimensional display, event property binding

articleTitle: Discrete Transform Methods of Solutions of the Fractional Difference Equations
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The fractional difference equations are encountered in many areas of applications, notably in control theory and control engineering, combinatorics, algebra, and mathematical analysis. In order to solve fractional differential equations conveniently, in this paper, the operational properties of fractional difference are studied. We begin with an introduction to the definitions of Delta left fractional difference of order α > 0, Nabla left fractional difference of order α > 0, Delta left fractional sum, and Nabla left fractional sum. Then we introduce the definitions and properties of Discrete R-Transform and Discrete N-transform. Finally, using the properties of fractional differential operation and discrete variation methods we obtain solutions of a class of fractional difference equations.

articleTitle: Boosted RVM Algorithm for Imbalanced and Noisy Data
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Relevance Vector Machine (RVM) is a machine learning algorithm based on sparse Bayesian theory, which performs good classification performance for small-scale data sets. However, it shows sub-optimal performance on noisy and imbalanced data sets. Therefore, a boosted RVM algorithm based on hybrid sampling and noise-detection (HSNDB-RVM) is proposed. In this approach, the imbalanced degree of samples is reduced by adopting a hybrid sampling method, and the impact of noise on the boosted RVM algorithm is weaken by decreasing the weight of noisy samples detected on top of RVM. The algorithm was applied to real data sets, and experimental results show that the proposed method offers good performance and can improve the ability of the RVM to process imbalanced and noisy data sets.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: Construction of Machine News Production System Based on Graph Database and Natural Language Generating Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The using of machine to write news automatically has greatly increased news' output and efficiency in media organizations. However, the number of news subject applicable to machine news writing technology is limited, and the form of machine news expression is relatively single. By analyzing the writing methods and principles of machine news and the characteristics of news materials storage database, as well as the types, sources and usage requirements of news information data, it was proposed that the data storage methods and production of machine news can be improved by using graph database tools and natural language generation technology; and then a machine news production system composed of four levels and nine modules was constructed, and the system's design ideas, logical framework and operation process were elaborated. The development and application of that system will broaden the field of machine news production and enrich the presentation of machine news.

articleTitle: Research of Three Axis Tracking and Pointing Platform Servo Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The design of stabilization and tracking loop controllers of tracking and pointing platform is considered in the paper. This design is based on mathematical model that the coupling among three-axis frame is considered. An state feedback H-infinite controller based on linear matrix inequality (LMI) is designed for stabilization loop of tracking and pointing platform. The observed structure decomposition for system is done and H-infinite filter is designed. Variable universe fuzzy PID controller for tracking loop is designed and some improvement is done. The simulation results show that the designed controllers have good performance.

articleTitle: A Cheat-Proof Secret Sharing Scheme Based on Algebraic Codes
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the security of information, we presented a cheat-proof secret sharing scheme based on [n; k] algebraic codes over F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub> in this paper. The scheme has very high security and information rate. It is easy to use this scheme to construct a new scheme from the constructed one without recovering secret, thus to increase or decrease the shareholders and to enlarge the subset of shares which can be used to recover the secret.

Author Keywords: Algebraic codes, Secret sharing, Authentication code, Threshold scheme, Cheat

articleTitle: Dynamic Phasor Estimates Based on Improved Taylor Weighted Least Squares
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Most phasor measurement algorithms consider signal phasors as a steady-state model, so they are very sensitive to voltage amplitude and angle fluctuations that often occur in modern power grids. Taylor weighted least squares (TWLS) algorithm relies on a dynamic phasor model at nominal frequency. The algorithm not only provides the phasor values but also provides its derivatives to improve the dynamic monitoring of the power grid. On this basis, an improved Taylor weighted least squares method is proposed. The Taylor weighted least squares algorithm based on the calculated fundamental frequency is introduced, and the window function, the length of the data window and Taylor polynomial order involved in the algorithm are analyzed and selected. Finally, different signal models and actual data are used to test the performance of the algorithm. The simulation results show that the accuracy of the improved TWLS algorithm meets the requirements of the synchronized phasor measurement.

Author Keywords: dynamic phasor model, phasor measurement, Taylor weighted least squares algorithm, window function

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Heterogeneous Database Synchronization Mechanism Based on the Netgap
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In allusion to the network environment of information communication using the netgap, this paper proposes a heterogeneous database synchronization mechanism based on the shadow table method. In this paper, the network environment of the netgap is described, and the overall architecture of the synchronization system is introduced, and the implementation of the module such as change data capture, incremental file generation, data synchronization operation and exception handling is proposed. Finally, the database synchronization mechanism is verified by the application of the data acquisition system of an organization.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Strong Tracking Combined Filtering Algorithm for MEMS Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Strong tracking kalman filter (STKF) algorithm has strong robustness and the ability to track state. In order to improve the filtering precision of STKF algorithm, this paper proposes an improved STKF algorithm to calculate the weakening factor on line, which is combined with the FIR filter to form a combined filter. The combined filter is implemented on DSP to realize real-time error compensation for MEMS gyroscope. The experimental results show that the combined filter not only has strong tracking ability for the state change of MEMS gyroscope, but also improves the filtering accuracy significantly, which makes the measurement noise of MEMS gyroscope in static and dynamic state be reduced by 93.6% and 63.9% respectively.

articleTitle: Phenotype Prediction of Pathogenic Nonsynonymous Single Nucleotide Polymorphisms in Insulin with Bioinformatics Tools
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Insulin is one of the most important hormones which coordinate the action of cells throughout the body for managing uptake, use and storage of blood sugar correctly. To date, about 329 single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNP) in the INS gene for insulin have been confirmed. Nonetheless, little is known about the relationship between phenotype and SNP genotype in the INS gene. Here, we analysed the INS nsSNPs using different computational methods and identified 16 nsSNPs to be potentially pathogenic. Furthermore, we used the ConSurf server to estimate the evolutionary conservation and distribution of amino acid positions in the insulin protein. The predicted pathogenic mutations acquired through this present study is expected to provide a guide for prioritizing the important nsSNPs to be selected for further wet lab evaluations and huge population based genotyping studies.

Author Keywords: Insulin, phenotype prediction, missense mutation, bioinformatics, evolutionary conservation

articleTitle: A Fast Image Matching Algorithm and the Application on Steel-Label Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a kind of image matching algorithm based on two steps matching process. This algorithm could measure the similarity between two images fast and accurately. In the first stage, the color ring-projection transforms the 2-D color image contained in a circular window into 1-D color signals as a function of radius. In the second stage process, a rotation invariance moments based on a set of complex polynomials are used to determine the final similarity. The proposed algorithm has shown promising result based on the experiments on steel-label recognition. It has a good robust performance and excellent computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Detecting Abnormal Events Using Locality-Sparse Tensor Reconstruction on Covariance Descriptors
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Abnormal event detection in videos is to find spatially or temporally isolated feature points that do not conform to a pre-defined notion of normal ones. Because the covariance descriptors can naturally fuse appearance and motion statistics, resulting in a much smaller dimensionality and compact representation than vector-based features. In this paper, we employ it as event representation, to capture the anomalies that different from normal patterns in appearance and motion simultaneously. Motivated by the application of tensor sparse coding, we propose a novel Locality-Sparse Tensor Reconstruction Model (LTR) to learn the covariance feature distribution for video events. The locality-sparse scheme makes the sample reconstructed only from its neighbourhoods, which bears much less computational complexity and obtain more robustness. To efficiently adapt new video data streams, we employ an online updates for the model. The proposed approach is evaluated on several publicly available datasets and outperforms several methods based on vector feature representation proposed before.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: Design of Simulation Training System of Self-Propelled Gun Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In recent years, training cost of army is increasing, it is necessary to save the training expenditure and improve the quality of training. This paper establishes a simulation training system of self-propelled gun based on virtual reality, distributed simulation and artificial intelligence. It introduces the design of system software. Simulation software of self-propelled gun information terminal consists of driver control panel, fire control panel, turret control panel, servo gun and so on. This paper analyzes the design process of each module and give its realization function in the form of block diagram. After testing, the results show that the system can simulate all kinds of skill operations and tactical drill and it greatly saves the cost of training.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of High-Speed LDPC Codec for Wireless Laser Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the improvement of the theory and the rapid development of the technology of laser communication, wireless laser communication has wider application fields. At the same time, people's requirements of information transmission rate in the communication system are constantly improving. Thus, Low Density Parity Check (LDPC) codes have become the first selection of channel coding with its excellent performance of error correction and low implementation complexity, but how to realize the efficient encoding and decoding of LDPC codes is the difficulty of the research. The encoding and decoding technology of LDPC codes as well as the wireless laser communication technology are the important issues. This paper will combine with these and mainly studies the actual application of LDPC codes in wireless laser communication. Then the codec of LDPC codes based on the CCSDS standard on the condition of high-speed communication is implemented with FPGA and the throughput can reach 2.5Gbps.

articleTitle: Quantitative Correlation and Causality Analysis on the Cause of Haze in Henan Province
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the frequent occurrence of fog and haze in China, more and more studies on the causes of haze and the impact on people's lives were carried out. In this paper, the causes of haze are analyzed in Henan province which is the Central Plains of China. Based on the official historical data, two methods, principal component analysis (PCA) and convergent cross mapping (CCM) are used to quantitative analysis the correlation and causality of the AQI, the concentration of pollutants and the meteorological factors. First, the correlation of air quality is analyzed in the cities of Henan Province, and then Zhengzhou was taken as the main research area in the following study. According to the principal component analysis of the pollutants concentration, the former two elements PM2.5 and CO with the meteorological factors are combined to carry out CCM causality analysis.

Author Keywords: correlation, causality, pollutants concentration, meteorological factors

articleTitle: A Feasible Method of Virtual Flow Field Simulation - Part II: Simulation and Visualization in RTT System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Dassault Systèmes' RTT system is a real-time virtual reality one that can achieve a virtual flow field simulation. However, the relative module is not only expensive, but also not satisfied in openness. A novel and feasible method is presented here to realize three-dimensional virtual streamlines based on RTT system without using the relative module in RTT system. In this part, the streamlines are imported into Autodesk Alias Automotive system via an IGES file, applied by the appropriate streamline type, and integrated with the vehicle model, which is used for the simulation in Fluent. The streamlines and the vehicle model are then imported into RTT system via a wire file. The virtual streamline simulation, like the smoke streamlines in the real wind tunnel test, has been achieved with the high quality through the real-time rendering of the streamlines and the vehicle model.

articleTitle: Effects of Loading Process on Performance of Weight-Fixed Loading Hydraulic System with Skip
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The hydraulic components and pipes of the weight-fixed loading hydraulic system with skip at Wangshiwa Coal Mine are easily damaged, and there also exists problems such as response hysteresis and inaccuracy. A simulation model of the weight-fixed loading hydraulic system in Wangshiwa was built with AMESim. According to the simulation model, the effects of loading process on the responding speed and accuracy of the weight-fixed loading hydraulic system with skip were studied. The results indicated that with the increasing of loaded coal, the overshoot, natural frequency and relative error of the system reduce, the damping ratio increases, and the adjusting time also increases slightly. The simulation of a working cycle indicates that the relative error of system is less than 0.09%, and the fix position of pressure transmitter among the hydraulic cylinder and electromagnetic reversing valve has no effect on measure results.

articleTitle: Notice of Removal: Fuzzy CMAC Nonsingular Sliding Mode Controller Design for a Robot Manipulator System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Removed.

articleTitle: Effect of the Compression Ratio of Die on the Extrusion Forming of the Plastic Pipes
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this work, the effect of die's compression ratio on the extrusion forming of plastic pipes was numerically studied by using the finite element software package Polyflow. The same inlet pressure was imposed on the inlet boundary of die with different compression ratios. Numerical results show that the extrudate swell ratio of plastic pipes increase with the compression ratio. To ascertain the mechanism of compression ratio on the extrudate swell of plastic pipes, the flow velocities, stress field distributions of melt with different compression ratios were obtained and compared. Results show that the flow velocities and stress values of melt all increase with the compression ratio. Finally, it is found that the reducing of the stay time in the channel and the increasing of the elastic store energies induced by the increased stresses is the mainly reason of increasing the extrudate swell phenomenon of plastic pipes when the compression ratio of die was increased.

articleTitle: Research on Optimizing Technologies of Testing the Verification Equipment for AC Electrical Energy Meters
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The problems encountered in testing the verification equipment for AC electrical energy meters according to the verification regulation are reviewed and analyzed, and the solutions based on optimizing technologies are proposed within the range permitted by the regulation. A self correction system is developed to improve the output reference conditions. The power stability and the ability to estimate it are improved, by adjusting the frequency and improving computing method. A new type of isolation transformer is designed to eliminate the system error caused by imbalanced transformer load.

Author Keywords: verification equipment for AC electrical energy meters

articleTitle: PSO-KNN Algorithm Based on Association Mining and Its Application in Undergraduate Professional Selection Guidance
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In recent years, universities have begun to dilute the concept of specific major direction at undergraduate level, and most undergraduates are faced with the problem of secondary professional selection. In order to better guide undergraduate students to choose the most suitable for their specific majors, while ensuring that the university's quality education resources can be reasonably allocated and utilized, universities should use the resources of educational big data to provide scientific undergraduate professional selection guidance. This paper takes this as a starting point and proposes a PSO-KNN algorithm based on association mining. Firstly, the optimized Apriori algorithm is used to find out the association rules between course achievement and professional selection, and the original data set is reduced dimensionally. Secondly, the most valuable professional choice is analyzed from educational data using the optimized PSO-KNN algorithm. Finally, the APK algorithm proposed in this paper is validated experimentally to prove the feasibility of the algorithm from the two dimensions of algorithm matching accuracy and running time, which provides a reference for universities to establish a scientific undergraduate professional selection guidance system.

articleTitle: Reliability Modeling for Complex System Based on Failure Network Digraph
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The traditional system reliability model for complex system exhibits deviation due to the overlook of failure correlation directionality among components. In order to rectify this problem, a new reliability modeling method for complex system is proposed based on failure network digraph technique. First, the failure network digraph is built with related failure mechanism analysis, and the component reliability models are built based on mean rank order. Then, taking the component reliability models as the marginal distribution, the system joint reliability function is developed with the introduction of the Copula function. Third, the parameter of Copula function is estimated with the aid of Kendall rank correlation coefficient obtained by samples. Finally, the method is applied to a machining center, the result shows that the new Copula function model considering failure correlation directionality is more rational and effective compared with the traditional Copula function model, which provides a theoretical basis for reliability evaluation and allocation of complex system.

articleTitle: A Method for Building Shared Massive Heterogeneous IoT Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet of Things (IoT), the IoT is characterized by a wide variety of data sources, large scale and heterogeneous structure. Those characteristics bring great difficulties to the storage and rapid retrieval of IoT data. By considering the common attributes of IoT data, based on plug-in ideas, combined with Redis and HBase, the paper proposes a framework named HSFRH-IoT, in order to build shared massive heterogeneous IoT data environment, which solves the problem of efficient storage and retrieval of massive heterogeneous IOT. Finally, the insertion and query performance of the proposed HSFRH-IoT framework is detailed tested, and the results shows that it has better performance than other RDBMS based solutions.

articleTitle: A Mixed Mahalanobis Kernel for Sparse Bayesian Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Relevance vector machine (RVM) is a typical sparse learning model. The most widely used kernel in RVM is Radial Basis Function (RBF), but it is based on the Euclidean distance and don't take the distribution information of training samples into consideration which sometimes leads to a poor performance. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a mixed Mahalanobis kernel for Sparse Bayesian classification which explores the distribution characteristics of data set by means of GMM, and built the kernel matrix based on the weighted Mahalanobis distances from all Gaussian components. The evaluation of the proposed kernel is conducted by means of kernel target alignment (KTA). Applying the proposed kernel to RVM, a new version of RVM, MM-RVM, is formed. The algorithm has been applied to several UCI datasets and the experimental results shows the superior performance of our proposed method and the effectiveness of the mixed Mahalanobis kernel.

articleTitle: Improve Power Flow Control and Performance Analysis of MVDC Grid Connected PV System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this study a control strategy of two-level Three-phase grid connected PV system by using SVPWM method is proposed for distribution and generation system. Traditional grid rectifier brings a lots of harmonics pollution, to decrease these harmonics, in this control system technique a double closed loop control based on. (ISMC). Integral Sliding Mode Control internal current loop and voltage control external loop is presented. The main objective of this controller is, low error (SS) steady state, enhanced voltage regulation, unity power factor, little (THD) total harmonic pollution distortion and small disturbance taken into consideration. By using Matlab/Simulink software simulation results shows the proposed control system is effective, good dynamics and fast response which open new insights in distribution systems.

Author Keywords: Three-phase PV inverter, double closed loop, sliding mode, SVPWM

articleTitle: Investigation on Gust Generator Experiment with Two Dimensions Hot Wire Anemometry
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Wind tunnel gust generator is important experiment equipment for gust load alleviation of aircrafts, however, there is less investigation on flow field performance parameter of gust generator. To investigate a gust generator composed of NACA0018 airfoil cascades, two dimensions hot wire anemometry is utilized to measure the flow field with different condition in a low turbulence wind tunnel. To estimate the performance parameter of flow field, online angle correction is used for improving the accuracy and efficiency of the two dimensions hot wire probe, phase analysis method is used for calculating the amplitude and fluctuation of periodic gust. The experiment of gust generator shows that, gust amplitude has a proportional relation with the NACA0018 airfoil oscillation frequency in range of 4Hz~15Hz, oscillation angle in range of 8°~30°, chord length in range of 50mm~100mm. Non-stability(velocity fluctuation at same phase) of gust flow has some linearity relation with oscillation angle and wind speed, which increases along with oscillation angle and wind speed in our test range, at the same time, proper oscillation frequency can decrease non-stability. The conclusion is helpful for gust generator research and flow field measurement in wind tunnel.

articleTitle: Research on Strip Head Telescope Control of Hot Strip Coiling Based on Orowan Uniform Compression Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The head telescope is one of the most important defects affecting the coiling quality in hot strip coiling. Currently, the head telescope is usually rectified forcedly by side guide which causes the side arch and deterioration of physical properties due to huge force. Aiming at the strip head telescope of a 750mm hot strip rolling line, the reasons of head telescope during coiling process are found, and the influences of related devices are analyzed. The way that controls the strip exit velocity through the bilateral forces of upper pinch roll based on Orowan uniform compression theory is firstly proposed to rectify the deflecting strip and improve strip head telescope. The strip moving trajectory from pinch roll to reel is simulated by ABAQUS. Simulation results show that the head telescope can be improved and even eliminated.

articleTitle: Vocational and Technological Teachers' Need for Trans-Disciplinary Teaching
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This research aimed to understand vocational and technological teachers' need for trans-disciplinary teaching. To achieve this purpose, this research took a total of 682 vocational and technological teachers as subjects and adopted the questionnaire method to collect data about teachers' degree of need for trans-disciplinary teaching as well as the expected improvement items. According to the research results, in terms of vocational and technological teachers' degree of need for trans-disciplinary teaching, teachers' industrial evaluation of supply and demand had the highest proportion, while stimulating knowledge acquisition showed the largest need for improvement. The results could provide a reference for vocational and technological educators to improve trans-disciplinary teaching and course development effectively.

articleTitle: Research of a Pattern Matching Algorithm Based on Statistical Eigenvalues
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The pattern matching algorithm has important influence on the performance of intrusion detection engine. Firstly, Paper analyses principle of the classic matching algorithm, including characteristic value and BMHS2 and frequency statistics algorithm. BMHS2 algorithm has a larger right moving distance when mismatching, the eigenvalue algorithm effectively reduces the number of matches by comparing the eigenvalue, the word frequency statistic algorithm can find the mismatch character as soon as possible. The improved single pattern algorithm firstly uses the frequency statistics method, the character of the lowest frequency in the pattern string is matched with the corresponding character of the text string; if matching, eigenvalue algorithm is used to compare the eigenvalue of pattern string and text substring; if it is still matching, the BMHS2 algorithm is used to fully match. In the above matching processes, if there are any mismatches, it uses computed right-move distance of BMHS2 algorithm to move the right. Test experiments show that in the same text string and pattern string, improved algorithm reduces the number of character matching and the matching performance is improved.

articleTitle: A Note on the Convergence of NURBS Curves When Weights Approach Infinity

abstract: In this paper, the convergence of NURBS curves is considered when the weights of a NURBS curve approach infinity. We prove that the limit of the NURBS curve does not exist as the weights tend to infinity and further study the convergence of NURBS curves about pointwise convergence, uniform convergence and L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> convergence.

articleTitle: Improved Ramptime Current Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Current control technology has rapidly developed as the increasingly popular application of power electronic equipment in power systems. Nonlinear current control technology has better control effects on the nonlinear structure of the inverter, so it has important research value. Considering that traditional ramptime current control cannot limit the peak of the current error between inverting current and reference current, a limiting module is added in the improved ramptime current controller. In this paper, the peak of the current error is limited so that the device can be protected while the quasi-fixed-frequency control can be achieved simultaneously. The simulation is accomplished in Matlab to verify the feasibility of improved ramptime current control strategy, which proves that improved control methods can realize accurate current tracking in the single-phase inverter.

articleTitle: Multimodal Biometric Person Recognition by Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Fusion for multimodal biometrics can be done in various levels. Among them, the score and decision fusion levels have been widely studied in the literature, but feature fusion level is a relatively understudied problem. This paper proposes a feature fusion method based on the Simulated Annealing (SA) technique. A study is conducted to compare the results obtained by the SA technique with the ones obtained by the Genetic Algorithm (GA). The experimental result shows that both methods achieve the same accuracy performance in feature fusion level, while the SA technique is computationally more efficient than the GA method.

Author Keywords: biometrics, multimodal biometrics, bimodal biometrics, feature extraction, fusion, Simulated Annealing, Genetic Algorithm
